content:
# =============================================================================
# e26-06 Medata SingleMA｜Shiny app
# 日期：2026-11-15
# 外觀：theme_v3 樣式表。
# 計算一律呼叫 core.R；輸入檢查、資安與圖檔輸出在 helpers_20261115_CSX.R；引用在 citation_meta.R。
# 不使用瀏覽器儲存空間與 cookie；不載入任何第三方資源。
# =============================================================================

library(shiny)
source("core.R", encoding = "UTF-8")

source("citation_meta.R", encoding = "UTF-8")
source("helpers_20261115_CSX.R", encoding = "UTF-8")

# ---- 版面（設計 v3）--------
TOOL_NAME <- sprintf("%s v%s", CITE_META$title, CITE_META$version)   # 名稱、版本、公司名、網址一律取自 CITE_META
type_choice <- function(b, d) tags$span(tags$b(b), tags$span(class = "hdh-choice__d", d))

# 對外連結集中一處（課程專屬頁建好後只改這裡）
LINKS <- list(site = "https://www.medatatw.com/", line = "https://lin.ee/QykLLdC",
              course = "https://medata.teaches.cc/training")
ext_a <- function(href, ..., class = "hdh-btn") tags$a(class = class, href = href, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener noreferrer", ...)

# 線性圖示（線性 SVG，不用 LINE 官方標誌）
svg_icon <- function(...) tags$svg(class = "hdh-icon", viewBox = "0 0 24 24", `aria-hidden` = "true", ...)
ic_quote  <- function() svg_icon(tags$path(d = "M9 7H5v6h4v-1a4 4 0 0 1-3 4M19 7h-4v6h4v-1a4 4 0 0 1-3 4"))
ic_chat   <- function() svg_icon(tags$path(d = "M4 5h16v11H9l-5 4z"))
ic_book   <- function() svg_icon(tags$path(d = "M4 5h7a3 3 0 0 1 3 3v12a2 2 0 0 0-2-2H4zM20 5h-3a3 3 0 0 0-3 3"),
                                 tags$path(d = "M14 20a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4V5"))
ic_globe  <- function() svg_icon(tags$circle(cx = "12", cy = "12", r = "8"),
                                 tags$path(d = "M4 12h16M12 4c3 3 3 13 0 16M12 4c-3 3-3 13 0 16"))

qr_block <- function() div(class = "hdh-qr",
  tags$img(class = "hdh-qr__img", src = "qr_line_medatatw_v2_20261115_CSX.png", alt = "加入匯東華 LINE 好友的 QR code"),
  tags$p(class = "hdh-qr__t", tags$b("用手機掃描，加 LINE 好友"), "掃描後會開啟 LINE 的加好友畫面：匯東華 @medatatw",
         tags$span("正在用手機？直接按「LINE @medatatw」按鈕。")))

# 兩種下載卡（投稿用／分享用），kind = forest／funnel
dl_cards <- function(kind) div(class = "hdh-dl",
  div(class = "hdh-dl__opt",
    tags$p(class = "hdh-dl__t", "投稿用（無標誌）"),
    tags$p(class = "hdh-dl__d", "期刊通常不接受帶標誌的圖，投稿請用這一份。"),
    div(class = "hdh-btnrow",
      actionButton(sprintf("dl_%s_png_sub", kind), "下載 PNG", class = "hdh-btn"),
      actionButton(sprintf("dl_%s_pdf_sub", kind), "下載 PDF", class = "hdh-btn"))),
  div(class = "hdh-dl__opt hdh-dl__opt--share",
    tags$p(class = "hdh-dl__t", "分享用（含匯東華標誌）"),
    tags$p(class = "hdh-dl__d", "放簡報、社群貼文或課堂報告時使用。"),
    div(class = "hdh-btnrow",
      actionButton(sprintf("dl_%s_png_share", kind), "下載 PNG", class = "hdh-btn"),
      actionButton(sprintf("dl_%s_pdf_share", kind), "下載 PDF", class = "hdh-btn"))),
  tags$p(class = "hdh-help", sprintf("PNG 寬 %s 像素（以 300 dpi 列印約 %.1f 公分寬）；PDF 為向量格式，可任意縮放。",
                                     format(FIG$css_w * FIG$scale, big.mark = ","), FIG$css_w * FIG$scale / 300 * 2.54)))

# 授權檔（隨網站提供於 legal/；app 在 iframe 內，連結由 app_20261115_CSX.js 換成網站根目錄下的 legal/）
legal_a <- function(file, label) tags$a(href = paste0("../legal/", file), `data-legal` = file, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", label)

# ======================= 確認視窗（自寫，不使用行內 script，符合 CSP）=======================
confirm_dialog <- div(id = "hdh-confirm", class = "hdh-modal", role = "alertdialog", `aria-modal` = "true",
  `aria-labelledby` = "hdh-confirm-text", hidden = NA,
  div(class = "hdh-modal__box hdh-confirm__box", tabindex = "-1",
    tags$p(id = "hdh-confirm-text", class = "hdh-lead"),
    div(class = "hdh-btnrow",
      tags$button(type = "button", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--solid", `data-confirm` = "ok", "繼續"),
      tags$button(type = "button", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--plain", `data-confirm` = "cancel", "取消"))))
ui <- bslib::page(title = sprintf("%s｜單組統合分析工具", CITE_META$title), theme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5), lang = "zh-Hant-TW",
  tags$head(
    # S5：只允許同網域資源（iframe 內的 Shiny 頁面）；不允許行內 script，連線只到同網域
    tags$meta(`http-equiv` = "Content-Security-Policy",
              content = paste("default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';",
                              "img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self';",
                              "object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'")),   # frame-ancestors 在 meta 標籤無效，故不列
    tags$link(rel = "icon", type = "image/png", href = "brand_lotus_w360_20261115_CSX.png"),
    tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", href = "theme_v3_20261115_CSX.css"),
    tags$link(rel = "stylesheet", href = "app_20261115_CSX.css"),
    tags$script(src = "app_20261115_CSX.js")
  ),
  # ======================= 頁首 =======================
  tags$header(class = "hdh-header", div(class = "hdh-header__in",
    tags$img(class = "hdh-logo", src = "brand_lotus_w360_20261115_CSX.png", alt = "匯東華標誌"),
    tags$p(class = "hdh-brand",
      tags$span(class = "hdh-wordmark", "Medata ", tags$b("SingleMA")),
      tags$span(class = "hdh-brand__sub", sprintf("單組統合分析工具　v%s　免費使用", CITE_META$version))),
    div(class = "hdh-header__right",
      tags$span(class = "hdh-tagline", "智。數據決策"),
      tags$button(type = "button", class = "hdh-btn", `data-open` = "cite", ic_quote(), "引用本工具"))
  )),
  div(class = "hdh-navwrap", tags$nav(class = "hdh-nav", role = "tablist", `aria-label` = "主選單",
    tags$button(class = "hdh-nav__btn", role = "tab", `aria-selected` = "true", `data-page` = "pg-run", "開始分析"),
    tags$button(class = "hdh-nav__btn", role = "tab", `aria-selected` = "false", `data-page` = "pg-teach", "教學提醒"),
    tags$button(class = "hdh-nav__btn", role = "tab", `aria-selected` = "false", `data-page` = "pg-privacy", "隱私說明"),
    tags$button(class = "hdh-nav__btn", role = "tab", `aria-selected` = "false", `data-page` = "pg-license", "引用與授權"),
    tags$button(class = "hdh-nav__btn", role = "tab", `aria-selected` = "false", `data-page` = "pg-about", "關於匯東華"))),
  div(class = "hdh-piibar", role = "note", div(class = "hdh-piibar__in",
    tags$strong("請勿輸入可識別個人的資料"), "（姓名、病歷號、身分證字號、生日等）。本工具只需要每篇研究的彙總數字。")),

  tags$main(class = "hdh-main",
    # ======================= 開始分析 =======================
    tags$section(id = "pg-run", class = "hdh-page", div(class = "hdh-layout",
      div(
        div(class = "hdh-card",
          div(class = "hdh-step", tags$span(class = "hdh-step__no", "1"), tags$h2(class = "hdh-step__t", "選擇資料類型")),
          div(class = "hdh-typechoice", radioButtons("type", NULL,
            choiceNames = list(type_choice("比例", "盛行率、累積發生率。每篇研究需要：事件數、總人數"),
                               type_choice("單組平均數", "例如平均住院天數。每篇研究需要：人數、平均數、標準差"),
                               type_choice("人時發生率", "例如每千人年發生數。每篇研究需要：事件數、觀察人時")),
            choiceValues = c("prop", "mean", "rate"), selected = "prop"))
        ),
        div(class = "hdh-card", id = "step2",
          div(class = "hdh-step", tags$span(class = "hdh-step__no", "2"), tags$h2(class = "hdh-step__t", "放入資料")),
          tags$p(class = "hdh-lead", "第一次使用？先按「載入示範資料」看看結果長什麼樣子。"),
          selectInput("demo", "示範資料", setNames(names(DEMOS), vapply(DEMOS, `[[`, "", "label")),
                      selected = DEMO_DEFAULT[["prop"]], selectize = FALSE),
          div(class = "hdh-btnrow",
            actionButton("load_demo", "載入示範資料", class = "hdh-btn"),
            actionButton("template", "下載空白範本", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--plain"),
            div(class = "hdh-upload", fileInput("upload", NULL, accept = c(".csv", ".tsv", "text/csv"),
                                                buttonLabel = "上傳 CSV 檔", placeholder = NULL))),
          div(id = "tpl_msg", class = "hdh-dlmsg", `aria-live` = "polite"),
          tags$p(class = "hdh-help", sprintf("上傳說明：請選擇 .csv 或 .tsv 檔，大小 2 MB 以內。第一列必須是欄位名稱。每篇研究一列，最多 %d 篇（篇數愈多計算愈久）。", LIMITS$max_rows),
                 tags$a(href = "#hdh-fmt-help", "看檔案格式說明")),
          textAreaInput("paste", "或從 Excel 複製後貼在這裡", value = "", rows = 7,
                        placeholder = PLACEHOLDER[["prop"]], resize = "vertical"),
          uiOutput("field_help"),
          tags$details(class = "hdh-details", tags$summary("每一欄要放什麼？"), div(tags$p(
            "study：研究名稱，例如「Wang 2020」，每篇不可重複（森林圖只能顯示英文字母，請用英文）｜events：發生事件的人數｜n：該研究的總人數｜mean：平均數｜sd：標準差｜time：觀察人時｜subgroup：分組名稱，例如地區或年代（選填）"))),
          tags$details(class = "hdh-details", tags$summary("檔案格式說明"), div(tags$ul(id = "hdh-fmt-help",
            tags$li("欄位順序不限，工具依欄位名稱辨認。"),
            tags$li("欄位名稱用英文，大小寫都可以（例如 Study、STUDY 都行）；前後多的空白會自動去掉。"),
            tags$li("多出來的欄位（例如 year、note）會被略過，並顯示提醒。"),
            tags$li("有中文字時，Excel 請另存成「CSV UTF-8（逗號分隔）」；存成一般「CSV（逗號分隔）」中文會變亂碼，工具會擋下並提醒。"),
            tags$li("研究名稱請用英文（例如 Wang 2020），每篇不可重複；中文名稱在下載的圖中會顯示成方框或符號。"),
            tags$li("檔名不影響分析。建議只用英文、數字與日期，例如 song2019_prevalence_20261116.csv，方便寄送與管理。"),
            tags$li("檔案格式：.csv 或 .tsv，2 MB 以內，最多 120 篇。")))),
          uiOutput("data_msg"),
          uiOutput("preview"),
          actionButton("clear", "清空資料", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--plain")
        ),
        div(class = "hdh-card",
          div(class = "hdh-step", tags$span(class = "hdh-step__no", "3"), tags$h2(class = "hdh-step__t", "按下方紅色按鈕「開始分析」")),
          tags$details(class = "hdh-details", tags$summary("分析設定（已有預設值，可以不更動）"), div(
            selectInput("sm", "效果量的轉換方式", SM_LABELS$prop, selectize = FALSE),
            uiOutput("pft_note"),
            selectInput("model", "合併模型", c("隨機效應（預設）" = "random", "固定效應" = "common"), selectize = FALSE),
            uiOutput("fixed_note"),
            selectInput("tau", "研究間變異 τ² 的估計法", TAU_LABELS, selectize = FALSE),
            checkboxInput("hk", "使用 Knapp–Hartung 調整", FALSE),
            checkboxInput("pi", "顯示預測區間", TRUE),
            selectInput("digits", "森林圖小數位數", c("2 位" = 2, "3 位" = 3, "4 位" = 4), selectize = FALSE),
            checkboxInput("use_sg", "依 subgroup 欄位做次群組分析", FALSE),
            uiOutput("sg_note")
          )),
          tags$p(class = "hdh-help", "更改資料或設定後，請再按一次，結果才會更新。")
        )
      ),
      div(
        # ---- 空白狀態：曇月靈 ----
        div(id = "results-placeholder", class = "hdh-card hdh-state", div(class = "hdh-empty",
          tags$figure(class = "hdh-mascot",
            tags$img(class = "hdh-mascot__img", src = "brand_mascot_tanyueling01_20261115_CSX.png", alt = "匯東華吉祥物曇月靈")),
          div(
            tags$p(class = "hdh-eyebrow", "曇月靈小提醒"),
            tags$h1(class = "hdh-h1", "結果會顯示在這裡"),
            tags$p(class = "hdh-lead", "完成左邊三個步驟後，這裡會出現森林圖、結果表，還有可以直接貼進論文的方法段落。"),
            tags$p(class = "hdh-lead", "第一次使用？按下面的按鈕，馬上看到範例結果。"),
            actionButton("load_demo2", "載入示範資料", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--solid")))),
        # ---- 分析完成 ----
        div(id = "results-wrap", class = "hdh-results-wrap hdh-results hdh-state", hidden = NA,
          div(class = "hdh-card",
            tags$h1(class = "hdh-h1", id = "results-title", "分析結果"),
            uiOutput("stale_msg"),
            tabsetPanel(id = "restab",
              tabPanel("森林圖", value = "forest",
                uiOutput("demo_ref"),
                tags$p(class = "hdh-scrollhint", "圖比螢幕寬時，可以左右滑動。"),
                div(class = "hdh-scroll", imageOutput("forest", width = "700px", height = "auto")),
                tags$p(class = "hdh-help", "畫面上的圖是「分享用」的樣子，右下角留白區有匯東華標誌。投稿請下載「投稿用」。"),
                uiOutput("forest_note"),
                dl_cards("forest"),
                div(id = "dl_msg", class = "hdh-dlmsg", `aria-live` = "polite"),
                div(class = "hdh-btnrow",
                  actionButton("dl_csv", "下載結果數字（CSV）", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--plain"),
                  tags$button(type = "button", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--plain", `data-open` = "cite", "引用本工具")),
                tags$details(class = "hdh-details", tags$summary("這張圖怎麼看？"), div(tags$p(
                  "每一列是一篇研究：方塊是該研究的估計值，橫線是 95% 信賴區間。紅色菱形是合併後的結果，菱形的寬度是合併值的 95% 信賴區間。最下方的紅色粗線是預測區間。")))),
              tabPanel("結果表", value = "table",
                tags$p(class = "hdh-scrollhint", "表格比螢幕寬時，可以左右滑動。"), uiOutput("res_table")),
              tabPanel("次群組", value = "sub", uiOutput("sub_table")),
              tabPanel("逐一排除", value = "loo",
                tags$p(class = "hdh-lead", "每次拿掉一篇研究後重新合併，用來看結果是否被單一研究左右。"),
                tags$p(class = "hdh-scrollhint", "表格比螢幕寬時，可以左右滑動。"), uiOutput("loo_table")),
              tabPanel("漏斗圖", value = "bias", uiOutput("bias_notes"),
                tags$p(class = "hdh-scrollhint", "圖比螢幕寬時，可以左右滑動。"),
                div(class = "hdh-scroll", imageOutput("funnel", width = "700px", height = "auto")),
                tags$p(class = "hdh-help", "畫面上的圖是「分享用」的樣子，右下角留白區有匯東華標誌。投稿請下載「投稿用」。"),
                uiOutput("bias_text"),
                dl_cards("funnel"),
                div(id = "dl_msg2", class = "hdh-dlmsg", `aria-live` = "polite")),
              tabPanel("方法段落", value = "method",
                tags$p(class = "hdh-lead", "依您的設定自動產生，可複製後貼到論文的方法章節，再依實際情況修改。"),
                tags$h3("中文"), uiOutput("text_zh"),
                tags$button(type = "button", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--plain", `data-copy` = "txt-zh", "複製中文段落"),
                tags$h3("English"), uiOutput("text_en"),
                tags$button(type = "button", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--plain", `data-copy` = "txt-en", "複製英文段落")),
              tabPanel("資料檢查", value = "dcheck",
                tags$p(class = "hdh-lead", "這次分析用到的每一篇研究都列在這裡，可以排序、搜尋，檢查有沒有輸入錯誤。"),
                uiOutput("dc_note"),
                uiOutput("dc_summary"),
                div(class = "hdh-dc-ctrl",
                  textInput("dc_q", "搜尋研究名稱或子群組", ""),
                  selectInput("dc_sort", "排序依據", c("原始順序" = "no"), selectize = FALSE),
                  selectInput("dc_dir", "順序", c("升冪（小到大）" = "asc", "降冪（大到小）" = "desc"), selectize = FALSE),
                  selectInput("dc_per", "每頁筆數", DC_PER_PAGE, selected = "20", selectize = FALSE)),
                tags$p(class = "hdh-scrollhint", "表格比螢幕寬時，可以左右滑動。"),
                uiOutput("dc_table"),
                div(class = "hdh-btnrow hdh-dc-pager",
                  actionButton("dc_prev", "上一頁", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--plain"),
                  tags$span(class = "hdh-dc-info", `aria-live` = "polite", textOutput("dc_info", inline = TRUE)),
                  actionButton("dc_next", "下一頁", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--plain")),
                tags$p(class = "hdh-help", "單篇值與標記只用來檢查資料，不參與合併計算。標記只說明資料的客觀狀況（例如事件數為 0），不代表資料有誤，也不會擋下分析。"))
            )
          ),
          # ---- 課程導流（只在分析完成後出現）----
          div(class = "hdh-cta",
            tags$p(class = "hdh-cta__t", tags$b("想把單組統合分析完整學一次？"),
                   "從資料整理、選模型到寫進論文，匯東華的實戰班帶您做完一遍。"),
            ext_a(LINKS$course, ic_book(), "看課程介紹", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--solid"),
            ext_a(LINKS$line, ic_chat(), "加 LINE 詢問 @medatatw")),
          qr_block()
        )
      )
    )),

    # ======================= 教學提醒 =======================
    tags$section(id = "pg-teach", class = "hdh-page", hidden = NA, div(class = "hdh-card",
      tags$h1(class = "hdh-h1", "教學提醒"),
      tags$p(class = "hdh-lead", "四件容易被忽略、但會影響結論的事。"),
      div(class = "hdh-note hdh-note--teach",
        tags$h3("1. Freeman–Tukey 轉換：把結果換回比例時要小心"),
        tags$p("Freeman–Tukey 雙反正弦轉換（PFT）合併後要換回比例時，公式需要代入一個『樣本數』；各研究樣本數不同時，換回的數字會隨代入的樣本數而變（常用調和平均數）。"),
        tags$p("各研究樣本數差距極大時（例如從幾十人到二十萬人），換回的合併比例可能嚴重失真，甚至比每一篇研究的比例都低。這是 Schwarzer 等人以實例呈現的結果；作者認為極端的樣本數分布是主因，並建議審慎使用 PFT。"),
        tags$p("本工具的預設是 Logit 轉換（PLOGIT）。如果您為了對照已發表的文獻而選用 PFT，建議同時看一次 PLOGIT 的結果，兩者差距大時要在論文中說明。"),
        tags$p(class = "hdh-help", "參考文獻："),
        tags$ul(class = "hdh-refs", tags$li("Schwarzer G, Chemaitelly H, Abu-Raddad LJ, Rücker G. (2019). Seriously misleading results using inverse of Freeman-Tukey double arcsine transformation in meta-analysis of single proportions. Res Synth Methods, 10(3), 476-483. doi:10.1002/jrsm.1348"))),
      div(class = "hdh-note hdh-note--teach",
        tags$h3("2. 比例資料的漏斗圖：請不要只憑它判斷發表偏誤"),

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  cur_type   <- reactiveVal("prop")
  res        <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  res_key    <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  auto_run   <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  load_msg   <- reactiveVal(NULL)    # S02/S04/E01/E14/E15/E16/E17：list(ui, level, key)，key 不等於目前資料時不顯示
  demo_src   <- reactiveVal(NULL)    # 最近一次載入的示範資料：list(key, tsv)
  cite_date  <- reactiveVal(Sys.Date())
  imgdir     <- tempfile("hdh_img_"); dir.create(imgdir)
  img_n      <- 0L
  session$onSessionEnded(function() unlink(imgdir, recursive = TRUE))

  set_run <- function(disabled, label) session$sendCustomMessage("hdh-run", list(disabled = disabled, label = label))
  # MLN 的錯誤訊息：效果量改成 MLN 以外時立即清除
  observeEvent(input$sm, { lm <- load_msg(); if (!identical(input$sm, "MLN") && !is.null(lm) && identical(lm$level, "err_mln")) load_msg(NULL) },
               ignoreInit = TRUE)
  # 確認視窗：由瀏覽器端顯示（app_20261115_CSX.js），按鈕結果以 input[[ok_id]]／input[[cancel_id]] 傳回
  confirm <- function(text, ok_label, ok_id, cancel_id)
    session$sendCustomMessage("hdh-confirm", list(text = text, ok = ok_label, okId = ok_id, cancelId = cancel_id))

  # ---- 步驟 1：切換資料類型（W08）----
  apply_type <- function(tp) {
    cur_type(tp)
    updateSelectInput(session, "sm", choices = SM_LABELS[[tp]])
    updateSelectInput(session, "demo", selected = DEMO_DEFAULT[[tp]])
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "paste", placeholder = PLACEHOLDER[[tp]])
  }
  observeEvent(input$type, {
    tp <- input$type
    if (identical(tp, cur_type())) return()
    if (nzchar(trimws(input$paste %||% ""))) {
      confirm("切換資料類型後，需要的欄位不同，目前的資料會被清空。要繼續嗎？", "繼續切換", "type_ok", "type_cancel")
    } else apply_type(tp)
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  observeEvent(input$type_ok, { updateTextAreaInput(session, "paste", value = ""); apply_type(input$type); load_msg(NULL) })

  observeEvent(input$type_cancel, updateRadioButtons(session, "type", selected = cur_type()))

  output$field_help <- renderUI(tags$p(class = "hdh-help", FIELD_HELP[[cur_type()]]))

  # ---- 步驟 2：示範資料、上傳、清空 ----
  observeEvent(input$load_demo2, load_demo_now())   # 空白狀態裡的［載入示範資料］
  observeEvent(input$load_demo, load_demo_now())
  load_demo_now <- function() {
    key <- input$demo; sp <- DEMOS[[key]]
    d <- demo_data(key); tsv <- df_to_tsv(d)
    if (!identical(sp$type, cur_type())) {
      apply_type(sp$type)
      updateRadioButtons(session, "type", selected = sp$type)
      updateSelectInput(session, "demo", selected = key)
    }
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "paste", value = tsv)
    src <- tagList(
      if (!is.null(sp$source)) tags$p(class = "hdh-help", "資料出處：", sp$source),
      tags$p(class = "hdh-help", sp$source_note))
    set_msg(tagList(note("ok", sprintf("已載入示範資料「%s」，共 %d 篇研究。", sp$label, nrow(d))), src),
            "ok", key = msg_key(sp$type, tsv))
    demo_src(list(key = key, tsv = tsv))
    auto_run(list(target = tsv, from = isolate(paste_d())))   # from：載入前的貼上框內容，用來辨認使用者是否中途改了內容
  }

  observeEvent(input$upload, {
    u <- check_upload(input$upload$datapath, input$upload$name, input$upload$size)
    if (!isTRUE(u$ok)) { set_msg(note("err", u$err), "err"); return() }
    tsv <- df_to_tsv(u$df)
    updateTextAreaInput(session, "paste", value = tsv)
    load_msg(NULL)
  })

  observeEvent(input$clear, confirm("確定要清空目前的資料嗎？", "清空", "clear_ok", "clear_cancel"))
  observeEvent(input$clear_ok, { updateTextAreaInput(session, "paste", value = "")
                                  set_msg(note("ok", "資料已清空。"), "ok", key = msg_key(cur_type(), "")) })

  # 下載：Shinylive 的 downloadHandler 在 Chromium 系瀏覽器實測會被取消，
  # 改由伺服器端送出 base64，瀏覽器端以 Blob 觸發下載。檔案只在本機記憶體內轉手，不經網路。
  # temp = TRUE 時送出後刪除暫存檔
  # box／ok：下載成功後要寫訊息的分頁容器與文字（由瀏覽器端在觸發下載之後寫，失敗則寫錯誤訊息）
  send_file <- function(path, name, mime, temp = TRUE, box = "dl_msg", ok = NULL) {   # box 未指定時寫到森林圖分頁的 dl_msg
    if (temp) on.exit(unlink(path), add = TRUE)
    b64 <- jsonlite::base64_enc(readBin(path, "raw", file.size(path)))
    session$sendCustomMessage("hdh-download", list(name = name, mime = mime, b64 = gsub("\n", "", b64, fixed = TRUE),
                                                   box = box, ok = ok))
  }
  observeEvent(input$template, {
    f <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
    utils::write.csv(blank_template(cur_type()), f, row.names = FALSE)
    send_file(f, sprintf("template_%s.csv", cur_type()), "text/csv", box = "tpl_msg")
  })

  # ---- 即時檢查 ----
  paste_d <- debounce(reactive(input$paste), 400)
  # 任何非預期錯誤都轉成訊息，不讓整個 session 中斷
  chk <- reactive(tryCatch(check_input(paste_d(), cur_type(), isTRUE(input$use_sg)),
    error = function(e) list(df = NULL, ok = FALSE, k = 0L, has_sg = FALSE, warns = character(),
                             errs = paste0("讀取貼上的內容時發生問題，請檢查資料格式。系統訊息：", conditionMessage(e)))))
  msg_key <- function(type, txt) paste(type, txt %||% "", sep = "\r")   # 訊息綁定的資料：資料類型＋貼上內容
  data_key <- reactive(msg_key(cur_type(), paste_d()))
  # 訊息綁定「當時的資料」：資料或資料類型改變後自動消失（key 預設為目前資料）
  set_msg <- function(ui, level, key = isolate(data_key())) load_msg(list(ui = ui, level = level, key = key))

  output$data_msg <- renderUI({
    c0 <- chk(); lm <- load_msg()
    items <- list(if (!is.null(lm) && identical(lm$key, data_key())) lm$ui)
    if (length(c0$errs)) items <- c(items, lapply(limit_errs(c0$errs), function(e) note("err", e)))
    else if (c0$ok) items <- c(items, list(note("ok", sprintf("已讀到 %d 篇研究，欄位齊全，可以開始分析。", c0$k))))
    if (length(c0$warns)) items <- c(items, lapply(limit_warns(c0$warns), function(w) note("warn", w)))
    tagList(items)
  })
  # 左欄只顯示一行確認摘要；完整資料表在結果區的「資料檢查」分頁
  output$preview <- renderUI({
    c0 <- chk(); req(c0$ok)
    cols <- names(c0$df_all %||% c0$df)
    tags$p(class = "hdh-help hdh-dc-line", sprintf("已讀入 %d 篇研究；欄位：%s", c0$k, paste(cols, collapse = "、")))
  })

  # ---- 設定的連動 ----
  output$pft_note <- renderUI(if (identical(input$sm, "PFT"))
    note("warn", "您選了 Freeman–Tukey 轉換。把結果換回比例時可能出現不合理的數值，詳見「教學提醒」第 1 則。"))
  observe({
    fixed <- identical(input$model, "common")
    session$sendCustomMessage("hdh-disable", list(ids = list("tau", "hk", "pi"), disabled = fixed))
  })
  output$fixed_note <- renderUI(if (identical(input$model, "common")) tags$p(class = "hdh-sidenote", "固定效應模型不使用這些設定。"))
  observe({
    has <- isTRUE(chk()$has_sg)
    session$sendCustomMessage("hdh-disable", list(ids = list("use_sg"), disabled = !has))
  })
  output$sg_note <- renderUI(if (!isTRUE(chk()$has_sg)) tags$p(class = "hdh-sidenote", "資料裡沒有 subgroup 欄位"))

  # ---- 分析 ----
  settings_key <- reactive(paste(paste_d(), cur_type(), input$sm, input$model, input$tau, input$hk,
                                 input$pi, input$digits, input$use_sg, sep = "|"))

  build_settings <- function() {
    tp <- cur_type(); smv <- input$sm
    glmm <- identical(smv, "GLMM")
    ma_settings(tp, if (glmm) "PLOGIT" else smv, model = input$model,
                method = if (glmm) "GLMM" else "Inverse",
                method.tau = input$tau, hk = isTRUE(input$hk), prediction = isTRUE(input$pi))
  }

  do_analysis <- function() {
    c0 <- chk()
    if (!isTRUE(c0$ok)) {
      if (!length(c0$errs)) set_msg(note("err", "還沒有資料。請在步驟 2 貼上資料，或按「載入示範資料」。"), "err")
      session$sendCustomMessage("hdh-goto", list(id = "step2"))   # 按鈕不停用，按下去帶到步驟 ②
      return(invisible())
    }
    tp <- cur_type(); dg <- as.integer(input$digits)
    dc_failed <- function() {   # 輸入通過、分析沒完成：資料檢查分頁顯示目前讀入的資料
      dc_fail(isolate(data_key()))
      session$sendCustomMessage("hdh-results", list(show = TRUE, scroll = TRUE))
      updateTabsetPanel(session, "restab", selected = "dcheck")
    }
    if (identical(input$sm, "MLN") && any(c0$df$mean <= 0)) {
      i <- which(c0$df$mean <= 0)[1]

                   error = function(e) list(ok = FALSE, msg = paste0("分析沒有完成。系統訊息：", conditionMessage(e))))

      r <- sa$res
      img_n <<- img_n + 1L
      # 畫面上顯示「分享用」圖（不透明標誌畫在加長的留白區，不用 CSS 疊圖）；配置（plan）留給下載重用

    pk <- c("meta", "metafor", "lme4", "shiny", "bslib", "htmltools", "jsonlite", "png")
    # 來源依建置時產生的「隨附套件版本對照表」（www/package_sources_*.csv：查 CRAN 現行版與 Archive），不從 DESCRIPTION 推斷
    src_line <- function(p) {
      v <- pkg_ver(p); if (is.na(v)) return(NULL)
      tags$li(sprintf("%s %s：%s", p, v, pkg_source_text(p, v)))
    }
    cran <- lapply(pk, src_line)
    wv <- pkg_ver("webr")
    tagList(tags$ul(class = "hdh-refs",
      tags$li(sprintf("R %s：https://cran.r-project.org/src/base/R-4/R-%s.tar.gz", rv, rv)),
      tags$li(sprintf("webR%s：https://github.com/r-wasm/webr", if (is.na(wv)) "" else paste0("（webr 套件 ", wv, "）"))),
      tags$li("Shinylive 0.10.10：https://github.com/posit-dev/shinylive"),
      cran),
      tags$p(class = "hdh-help", "其餘套件、瀏覽器端程式庫與字型的版本、授權與原始碼來源，見上方的第三方授權清單。"))
  })
  output$citations <- renderUI({
    pk <- c(R = "base", meta = "meta", metafor = "metafor", shiny = "shiny", webR = "webr")
    blocks <- lapply(names(pk), function(lab) {
      txt <- pkg_citation(pk[[lab]])
      if (is.na(txt))
        return(tagList(tags$h3(lab), div(class = "hdh-placeholder",
          sprintf("此執行環境沒有 %s 套件，無法以 citation() 產生引用文字。", pk[[lab]]))))
      id <- paste0("pkgcite-", lab)
      tagList(tags$h3(lab), div(id = id, class = "hdh-pre", txt),
              tags$button(type = "button", class = "hdh-btn hdh-btn--plain", `data-copy` = id, "複製"))
    })
    tagList(blocks)
  })
  output$licenses <- renderUI(tags$p(class = "hdh-help", "執行環境回報的授權欄位：",
    paste(vapply(c("meta", "metafor", "shiny"), function(p)
      sprintf("%s：%s", p, utils::packageDescription(p)$License), ""), collapse = "｜")))
  # 這些內容放在一開始隱藏的分頁或引用視窗裡；Shiny 預設不算隱藏的輸出，這裡改為一律先算好（內容小、不含使用者資料）
  for (id in c("cite_rows", "citations", "versions_block", "licenses", "foot_versions", "source_list"))
    outputOptions(output, id, suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)
}

content: # ============================================================================= # Medata SingleMA｜引用後設資料（唯一來源）與五種格式產生器 # 日期：2026-11-15 # 依據：APA 第 7 版的軟體引用格式；Vancouver、MLA、BibTeX、RIS 依各格式的通用寫法。 # 五種格式的標題一律為「Medata SingleMA」，不帶副標題。 # 規則： # - 本工具的引用只從 CITE_META 產生，任何格式都不另寫書目內容。 # - R、meta、metafor 等軟體的引用一律由 citation() 產生，不寫死。 # - 每個格式回傳 list(text = 純文字, html = 已跳脫的 HTML 字串（斜體以 表示）, tag = htmltools 物件（不需 HTML()）)。 # - 日期由呼叫端傳入（預設今天），月份縮寫用固定英文表，不受系統語系影響。 # ============================================================================= CITE_META <- list( title = "Medata SingleMA", # 五種格式共用，不帶副標題 version = "1.0", year = "2026", author_family = "Chen", author_given = "Hsiu-Min", author_apa = "Chen, H.-M.", author_nlm = "Chen HM", publisher_full = "Medata Statistical Consulting Co., Ltd.", publisher_apa = "Medata Statistical Consulting", # APA 省略 Co., Ltd. publisher_zh = "匯東華統計顧問有限公司", url = "https://singlema.medatatw.com", doi = NULL, # 取得 DOI 後填入；有值時各格式改用 DOI bibkey = "chen2026singlema" ) .MONTH_ABB <- c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec") .esc <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(x) .date_parts <- function(d) list(y = format(d, "%Y"), m = as.integer(format(d, "%m")), d = as.integer(format(d, "%d"))) cite_apa <- function(meta = CITE_META) { loc <- if (!is.null(meta$doi)) paste0("https://doi.org/", meta$doi) else meta$url pre <- sprintf("%s (%s). ", meta$author_apa, meta$year) post <- sprintf(" (Version %s) [Computer software]. %s. %s", meta$version, meta$publisher_apa, loc) list(text = paste0(pre, meta$title, post), html = paste0(.esc(pre), "", .esc(meta$title), "", .esc(post)), tag = htmltools::tagList(pre, htmltools::tags$i(meta$title, .noWS = "outside"), post)) } cite_vancouver <- function(meta = CITE_META, date = Sys.Date()) { p <- .date_parts(date) loc <- if (!is.null(meta$doi)) paste0("https://doi.org/", meta$doi) else meta$url txt <- sprintf("%s. %s. Version %s [software]. %s; %s [cited %s %s %d]. Available from: %s", meta$author_nlm, meta$title, meta$version, meta$publisher_full, meta$year, p$y, .MONTH_ABB[p$m], p$d, loc) list(text = txt, html = .esc(txt), tag = txt) } cite_mla <- function(meta = CITE_META, date = Sys.Date(), accessed = FALSE) { p <- .date_parts(date) loc <- if (!is.null(meta$doi)) paste0("https://doi.org/", meta$doi) else sub("^https?://", "", meta$url) pre <- sprintf("%s, %s. ", meta$author_family, meta$author_given) post <- sprintf(". Version %s, %s, %s, %s.", meta$version, meta$publisher_full, meta$year, loc) if (accessed) post <- paste0(post, sprintf(" Accessed %d %s. %s.", p$d, .MONTH_ABB[p$m], p$y)) list(text = paste0(pre, meta$title, post), html = paste0(.esc(pre), "", .esc(meta$title), "", .esc(post)), tag = htmltools::tagList(pre, htmltools::tags$i(meta$title, .noWS = "outside"), post)) } cite_bibtex <- function(meta = CITE_META, date = Sys.Date(), type = c("misc", "software")) { type <- match.arg(type) title_bib <- sub("SingleMA", "{SingleMA}", meta$title, fixed = TRUE) f <- c(author = sprintf("{%s, %s}", meta$author_family, meta$author_given), title = sprintf("{%s}", title_bib), version = sprintf("{%s}", meta$version), year = sprintf("{%s}", meta$year), organization = sprintf("{%s}", meta$publisher_full), url = sprintf("{%s}", meta$url), urldate = sprintf("{%s}", format(date, "%Y-%m-%d"))) if (!is.null(meta$doi)) f <- c(f, doi = sprintf("{%s}", meta$doi)) w <- max(nchar(names(f))) body <- sprintf(" %-*s = %s,", w, names(f), f) txt <- paste(c(sprintf("@%s{%s,", type, meta$bibkey), body, "}"), collapse = "\n") list(text = txt, html = .esc(txt), tag = txt) } cite_ris <- function(meta = CITE_META, date = Sys.Date(), type = c("COMP", "ELEC")) { type <- match.arg(type) lines <- c(sprintf("TY - %s", type), sprintf("AU - %s, %s", meta$author_family, meta$author_given), sprintf("TI - %s", meta$title), sprintf("ET - %s", meta$version), sprintf("PY - %s", meta$year), sprintf("PB - %s", meta$publisher_full), sprintf("UR - %s", meta$url), sprintf("Y2 - %s", format(date, "%Y/%m/%d"))) if (!is.null(meta$doi)) lines <- c(lines, sprintf("DO - %s", meta$doi)) txt <- paste(c(lines, "ER - ", ""), collapse = "\r\n") # RIS 以 CRLF 換行 list(text = txt, html = .esc(txt), tag = txt) } #' 本工具五種格式 tool_citations <- function(date = Sys.Date(), meta = CITE_META) { list(APA = cite_apa(meta), Vancouver = cite_vancouver(meta, date), MLA = cite_mla(meta, date), BibTeX = cite_bibtex(meta, date), RIS = cite_ris(meta, date)) } #' 套件 DESCRIPTION 的年份（citation() 自動產生的引用缺年份時使用）：Date/Publication → Date → Packaged → Built .desc_year <- function(pkg) { d <- tryCatch(utils::packageDescription(pkg), error = function(e) NULL, warning = function(w) NULL) if (is.null(d) || !is.list(d)) return(NA_character_) for (f in c("Date/Publication", "Date", "Packaged", "Built")) { # Built：開發版沒有發布日期時，以建置日期的年份代替 v <- d[[f]]; if (is.null(v)) next y <- regmatches(v, regexpr("(19|20)[0-9]{2}", v)) if (length(y) == 1) return(y) } NA_character_ } #' citation() 的 text 樣式帶有純文字標記（_斜體_、*粗體*、<網址>）與固定寬度斷行，整理成一般文字 clean_cite_text <- function(x) { x <- gsub("\\s*\n\\s*", " ", x) x <- gsub("<((https?|ftp)://[^>]+)>", "\\1", x) x <- gsub("(^|[ (\u201c\"])_([^_]+)_", "\\1\\2", x, perl = TRUE) x <- gsub("\\*([^*]+)\\*", "\\1", x) trimws(x) } #' R 與套件的引用：一律由 citation() 產生，再整理成純文字；缺年份時取 DESCRIPTION 的日期，仍取不到寫 n.d. #' 取不到 citation() 時回傳 NA，由介面顯示原因 pkg_citation <- function(pkg = "base", style = c("text", "bibtex")) { style <- match.arg(style) ci <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(utils::citation(pkg)), error = function(e) NULL) if (is.null(ci)) return(NA_character_) ents <- lapply(seq_along(ci), function(i) { e <- ci[i] if (is.null(e$year) || !grepl("[0-9]{4}", e$year)) { y <- .desc_year(pkg); e$year <- if (is.na(y)) "n.d." else y } e }) ci <- do.call(c, ents) if (style == "bibtex") paste(format(utils::toBibtex(ci)), collapse = "\n") else paste(clean_cite_text(format(ci, style = "text")), collapse = "\n\n") }

# =============================================================================
# e26-06 單組統合分析網頁工具｜計算核心 core.R
# 日期：2026-11-15｜計算核心
#
# 原則
#   - 所有統計量一律由 R `meta` 套件計算（metaprop / metamean / metarate /
#     metainf / metabias / estimates / backtransf）。本檔不自行實作任何統計公式，
#     只負責：整理輸入、組合參數、從 meta 物件取值。計算結果保留完整精度，
#     取位只在輸出時做（CSV 取 10 位有效數字；畫面與圖由介面層格式化）。
#   - 本檔不含任何 shiny / UI 程式碼，可在本機 R 與 webR 共用。
#   - 目標版本：meta 8.3-0、metafor 4.8-0。
# =============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(meta))

CORE_VERSION <- "0.1.0"
SIGNIF_OUT   <- 10L   # 結果 CSV 的有效位數（只在輸出時取位）

# ---- 常數 -------------------------------------------------------------------

TYPES <- c("prop", "mean", "rate")

SM_CHOICES <- list(
  prop = c("PLOGIT", "PFT", "PAS", "PRAW", "PLN"),
  mean = c("MRAW", "MLN"),
  rate = c("IRLN", "IR")
)

# GLMM 在 meta 中僅能搭配下列效果量（metaprop: PLOGIT；metarate: IRLN）
GLMM_SM <- c(prop = "PLOGIT", rate = "IRLN")

TAU_CHOICES <- c("REML", "DL", "PM", "SJ")

INPUT_COLS <- list(
  prop = c("study", "events", "n"),
  mean = c("study", "n", "mean", "sd"),
  rate = c("study", "events", "time")
)

# 示範資料：demo/ 內檔案的欄位對應（canonical = 原欄名）
DEMO_SPECS <- list(
  song2019 = list(file = "song2019_htn_input_20261115_CSX.csv", type = "prop",
                  map = c(study = "study", events = "events_used", n = "n_used"),
                  subgroup = "setting"),
  mean     = list(file = "demo_mean_20261115_CSX.csv", type = "mean",
                  map = c(study = "s", n = "n", mean = "m", sd = "sd"),
                  subgroup = NULL),
  rate     = list(file = "demo_rate_20261115_CSX.csv", type = "rate",
                  map = c(study = "s", events = "ev", time = "pt"),
                  subgroup = "g")
)

# ---- 小工具 -----------------------------------------------------------------

signif_df <- function(df) {
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) signif(x, SIGNIF_OUT) else x)
  df
}

first_num <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else as.numeric(x[1])

is_rate_sm <- function(sm) sm %in% c("IR", "IRLN", "IRS", "IRFT")

# ---- 設定 -------------------------------------------------------------------

#' 建立並檢查分析設定
#' @param type "prop" / "mean" / "rate"
#' @param sm 效果量；NULL 時用該類型的預設（第一個）
#' @param model "random" 或 "common"
#' @param method "Inverse"（反變異數）或 "GLMM"（僅 prop / rate）
#' @param method.tau "REML" / "DL" / "PM" / "SJ"；GLMM 時 meta 只接受 "ML"，會自動改為 ML
#' @param hk 是否使用 Knapp–Hartung（meta: method.random.ci = "HK"）
#' @param prediction 是否計算預測區間（僅隨機效應模型）
ma_settings <- function(type, sm = NULL, model = "random", method = "Inverse",
                        method.tau = "REML", hk = FALSE, prediction = TRUE,
                        level = 0.95) {
  type <- match.arg(type, TYPES)
  if (is.null(sm)) sm <- SM_CHOICES[[type]][1]
  if (!sm %in% SM_CHOICES[[type]])
    stop(sprintf("效果量 %s 不適用於資料類型 %s", sm, type))
  model  <- match.arg(model, c("random", "common"))
  method <- match.arg(method, c("Inverse", "GLMM"))
  notes  <- character()
  if (method == "GLMM") {
    if (type == "mean") stop("GLMM 不適用於單組平均數")
    if (sm != GLMM_SM[[type]])
      stop(sprintf("GLMM 只能搭配效果量 %s（meta 的限制）", GLMM_SM[[type]]))
    if (method.tau != "ML")
      notes <- c(notes, sprintf("GLMM 僅支援 ML 估計 tau^2，已由 %s 改為 ML", method.tau))
    method.tau <- "ML"
  } else if (!method.tau %in% TAU_CHOICES) {
    stop(sprintf("tau^2 估計法 %s 不在選項內", method.tau))
  }
  if (model == "common" && hk)
    notes <- c(notes, "Knapp-Hartung 只用於隨機效應模型；固定效應模型不受影響")
  structure(list(type = type, sm = sm, model = model, method = method,
                 method.tau = method.tau, hk = isTRUE(hk),
                 prediction = isTRUE(prediction) && model == "random",
                 level = level, notes = notes),
            class = "ma_settings")
}

# ---- 輸入 -------------------------------------------------------------------

#' 空白範本（給使用者下載）
blank_template <- function(type, subgroup = TRUE) {
  type <- match.arg(type, TYPES)
  cols <- INPUT_COLS[[type]]
  if (subgroup) cols <- c(cols, "subgroup")
  df <- as.data.frame(setNames(replicate(length(cols), character(0), simplify = FALSE), cols))
  df
}

#' 解析從 Excel 貼上的文字（Tab 分隔；若無 Tab 則視為逗號分隔），第一列為欄名
parse_pasted <- function(text) {
  text <- gsub("\r\n?", "\n", text)
  text <- sub("\n+$", "", text)
  if (!nzchar(trimws(text))) stop("貼上的內容是空的")
  sep <- if (grepl("\t", text, fixed = TRUE)) "\t" else ","
  utils::read.table(text = text, header = TRUE, sep = sep, quote = "\"",
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                    strip.white = TRUE, comment.char = "")
}

#' 將欄位改成標準名稱，並保留選填的 subgroup 欄
#' @param map 具名字元向量 c(標準名 = 原欄名)；NULL 時假設已是標準名
#' @param subgroup 原資料中作為次群組的欄名；NULL 時若有 "subgroup" 欄則沿用
standardize_input <- function(df, type, map = NULL, subgroup = NULL) {
  type <- match.arg(type, TYPES)
  df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(df) <- trimws(names(df))
  need <- INPUT_COLS[[type]]
  if (is.null(map)) map <- setNames(need, need)
  miss <- setdiff(need, names(map))
  if (length(miss)) stop("欄位對應缺少：", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  absent <- setdiff(unname(map[need]), names(df))
  if (length(absent)) stop("資料中找不到欄位：", paste(absent, collapse = ", "))
  out <- data.frame(study = as.character(df[[map[["study"]]]]), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (v in setdiff(need, "study")) {
    x <- df[[map[[v]]]]
    out[[v]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", as.character(x))))
  }
  if (is.null(subgroup) && "subgroup" %in% names(df)) subgroup <- "subgroup"
  if (!is.null(subgroup)) {
    if (!subgroup %in% names(df)) stop("資料中找不到次群組欄位：", subgroup)
    sg <- trimws(as.character(df[[subgroup]]))
    if (!all(is.na(sg) | sg == "")) out$subgroup <- sg
  }
  out
}

#' 檢查輸入；回傳錯誤訊息字元向量（長度 0 = 通過）
validate_input <- function(df, settings) {
  type <- settings$type
  err <- character()
  need <- INPUT_COLS[[type]]
  miss <- setdiff(need, names(df))
  if (length(miss)) return(paste("缺少欄位：", paste(miss, collapse = ", ")))
  k <- nrow(df)
  if (k < 2) err <- c(err, sprintf("研究數 k = %d，至少需要 2 篇", k))
  if (any(is.na(df$study) | trimws(df$study) == ""))
    err <- c(err, "study 欄有空白")
  if (anyDuplicated(df$study)) err <- c(err, "study 名稱重複：請讓每篇研究名稱唯一")
  num <- setdiff(need, "study")
  for (v in num) {
    bad <- which(is.na(df[[v]]))
    if (length(bad)) err <- c(err, sprintf("%s 欄第 %s 列不是數字或空白", v, paste(bad, collapse = ",")))
  }
  if (length(err)) return(err)
  if (type %in% c("prop", "rate")) {
    if (any(df$events < 0)) err <- c(err, "events 不可為負數")
    if (any(df$events != round(df$events))) err <- c(err, "events 必須是整數")
  }
  if (type == "prop") {
    if (any(df$n <= 0)) err <- c(err, "n 必須大於 0")
    if (any(df$events > df$n)) err <- c(err, "events 不可大於 n")
  }
  if (type == "mean") {
    if (any(df$n <= 0)) err <- c(err, "n 必須大於 0")
    if (any(df$sd <= 0)) err <- c(err, "sd 必須大於 0")
    if (settings$sm == "MLN" && any(df$mean <= 0))
      err <- c(err, "MLN（對數轉換）要求所有平均數大於 0")
  }
  if (type == "rate" && any(df$time <= 0)) err <- c(err, "time 必須大於 0")
  if ("subgroup" %in% names(df) && any(is.na(df$subgroup) | df$subgroup == ""))
    err <- c(err, "subgroup 欄有部分空白：請全部填寫或整欄留空")
  err
}

#' 讀取示範資料（data_dir 為 demo/ 所在路徑）
load_demo <- function(name, data_dir, with_subgroup = FALSE) {
  spec <- DEMO_SPECS[[name]]
  if (is.null(spec)) stop("未知的示範資料：", name)
  raw <- utils::read.csv(file.path(data_dir, spec$file), stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                         check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  sg <- if (with_subgroup) spec$subgroup else NULL
  list(type = spec$type, data = standardize_input(raw, spec$type, spec$map, sg))
}

# ---- 主計算 -----------------------------------------------------------------

#' 呼叫 meta 套件做合併；回傳 meta 物件，警告訊息存在 attr(, "warnings")
run_meta <- function(df, settings) {
  stopifnot(inherits(settings, "ma_settings"))
  errs <- validate_input(df, settings)
  if (length(errs)) stop(paste(errs, collapse = "；"))
  has_sg <- "subgroup" %in% names(df) && length(unique(df$subgroup)) >= 2
  args <- list(
    studlab    = df$study,
    sm         = settings$sm,
    common     = settings$model == "common",
    random     = settings$model == "random",
    prediction = settings$prediction,
    method.tau = settings$method.tau,
    method.random.ci = if (settings$hk) "HK" else "classic",
    level      = settings$level,
    level.ma   = settings$level
  )
  if (has_sg) args$subgroup <- df$subgroup
  fun <- switch(settings$type,
    prop = { args$event <- df$events; args$n <- df$n; args$method <- settings$method; meta::metaprop },
    mean = { args$n <- df$n; args$mean <- df$mean; args$sd <- df$sd; meta::metamean },
    rate = { args$event <- df$events; args$time <- df$time; args$method <- settings$method; meta::metarate }
  )
  warns <- character()
  m <- withCallingHandlers(do.call(fun, args),
    warning = function(w) { warns <<- c(warns, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") })
  attr(m, "warnings") <- unique(c(settings$notes, warns))
  attr(m, "settings") <- settings
  attr(m, "data") <- df
  m
}

# 取 estimates() 的結果（meta 自己做還原轉換），去掉附帶的 x 屬性
.estimates_df <- function(m, ...) {
  e <- meta::estimates(m, digits = 15, ...)
  df <- as.data.frame(e, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  attr(df, "x") <- NULL
  df
}

.model_fields <- function(m) {
  s <- attr(m, "settings")
  if (s$model == "random")
    list(lab = m$text.random, TE = "TE.random", lo = "lower.random", up = "upper.random",
         w = "w.random", Qb = "Q.b.random", dfQb = "df.Q.b.random", pQb = "pval.Q.b.random")
  else
    list(lab = m$text.common, TE = "TE.common", lo = "lower.common", up = "upper.common",
         w = "w.common", Qb = "Q.b.common", dfQb = "df.Q.b.common", pQb = "pval.Q.b.common")
}

#' 合併結果（一列）：還原後的合併值、CI、PI，以及 tau^2、I^2（%）、Q、df、p
pooled_table <- function(m) {
  s  <- attr(m, "settings")
  mf <- .model_fields(m)
  e  <- .estimates_df(m, study.results = FALSE, subgroup = FALSE)
  row <- e[e$studlab == mf$lab, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) != 1) stop("estimates() 找不到合併列：", mf$lab)
  pi <- e[e$studlab == m$text.predict, , drop = FALSE]
  has_pi <- isTRUE(m$prediction) && nrow(pi) == 1
  glmm <- identical(m$method, "GLMM")
  out <- data.frame(
    type = s$type, sm = s$sm, model = s$model, method = m$method,
    method.tau = m$method.tau, hk = s$hk, k = m$k,
    estimate = row$estimate, lower = row$lower, upper = row$upper,
    pi_lower = if (has_pi) pi$lower else NA_real_,
    pi_upper = if (has_pi) pi$upper else NA_real_,
    TE = m[[mf$TE]], TE_lower = m[[mf$lo]], TE_upper = m[[mf$up]],
    tau2 = first_num(m$tau2), tau = first_num(m$tau),
    I2_pct = 100 * first_num(m$I2),
    I2_lower_pct = 100 * first_num(m$lower.I2), I2_upper_pct = 100 * first_num(m$upper.I2),
    Q = first_num(m$Q), df_Q = first_num(m$df.Q), pval_Q = first_num(m$pval.Q),
    # GLMM 的 Q 有兩種（Wald 型與 LRT），meta 依序給出；上面 Q 取第一個（Wald）
    Q_LRT = if (glmm && length(m$Q) >= 2) as.numeric(m$Q[2]) else NA_real_,
    pval_Q_LRT = if (glmm && length(m$pval.Q) >= 2) as.numeric(m$pval.Q[2]) else NA_real_,
    method.predict = if (has_pi) m$method.predict else NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out
}

#' 各研究結果：還原後的效果量與 CI、權重（%）
study_table <- function(m) {
  mf <- .model_fields(m)
  e  <- .estimates_df(m, study.results = TRUE, subgroup = FALSE)
  k  <- length(m$studlab)
  st <- e[seq_len(k), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!identical(as.character(st$studlab), as.character(m$studlab)))
    stop("estimates() 的研究列順序與 meta 物件不符")
  w <- m[[mf$w]]
  wpct <- if (is.null(w) || all(is.na(w))) rep(NA_real_, k) else 100 * w / sum(w, na.rm = TRUE)
  out <- data.frame(study = st$studlab, estimate = st$estimate, lower = st$lower,
                    upper = st$upper, TE = m$TE, seTE = m$seTE, weight_pct = wpct,
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(m$subgroup)) out$subgroup <- m$subgroup
  out
}

#' 次群組：各組結果與組間差異檢定；無次群組時回傳 NULL
subgroup_table <- function(m) {
  if (is.null(m$subgroup)) return(NULL)
  mf  <- .model_fields(m)
  lev <- m$subgroup.levels
  e   <- .estimates_df(m, study.results = FALSE, subgroup = TRUE)
  rows <- e[e$studlab == mf$lab & e$subgroup %in% lev, , drop = FALSE]
  rows <- rows[match(lev, rows$subgroup), , drop = FALSE]
  if (any(is.na(rows$subgroup))) stop("estimates() 的次群組列與 subgroup.levels 不符")
  vec <- function(nm) { x <- m[[nm]]; if (is.null(x)) rep(NA_real_, length(lev)) else as.numeric(x)[seq_along(lev)] }
  groups <- data.frame(
    subgroup = lev, k = vec("k.w"),
    estimate = rows$estimate, lower = rows$lower, upper = rows$upper,
    tau2 = vec("tau2.w"), I2_pct = 100 * vec("I2.w"),
    Q = vec("Q.w"), pval_Q = vec("pval.Q.w"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  # meta 只存「組內 df 合計」（df.Q.w，單一值），不存各組 df，故放在組間表
  between <- data.frame(Q_between = first_num(m[[mf$Qb]]),
                        df_between = first_num(m[[mf$dfQb]]),
                        pval_between = first_num(m[[mf$pQb]]),
                        df_within_total = first_num(m$df.Q.w))
  list(groups = groups, between = between)
}

#' Leave-one-out：meta::metainf，再以 meta::backtransf 還原（與 print.metacum 相同作法）
loo_table <- function(m) {
  s  <- attr(m, "settings")
  mi <- suppressWarnings(meta::metainf(m, pooled = s$model))
  hm <- if (is_rate_sm(m$sm)) mi$t.harmonic.mean else mi$n.harmonic.mean
  bt <- function(x) if (isTRUE(mi$backtransf)) meta::backtransf(x, m$sm, hm, hm) else x
  out <- data.frame(
    omitted = mi$studlab,
    estimate = bt(mi$TE), lower = bt(mi$lower), upper = bt(mi$upper),
    pi_lower = if (isTRUE(s$prediction)) bt(mi$lower.predict) else NA_real_,
    pi_upper = if (isTRUE(s$prediction)) bt(mi$upper.predict) else NA_real_,
    tau2 = mi$tau2, I2_pct = 100 * mi$I2,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  out
}

#' 小樣本效應檢定（Egger、Begg）＋警示旗標
#' k < 3 時 meta 無法計算；k < 10 時仍計算但標示 warn_k
bias_table <- function(m) {
  s <- attr(m, "settings")
  # 有次群組時 metabias 會改成逐組檢定；這裡要的是整體檢定，故以去掉 subgroup 的資料重跑
  if (!is.null(m$subgroup)) {
    d <- attr(m, "data"); d$subgroup <- NULL
    m <- run_meta(d, s)
  }
  k <- m$k
  one <- function(meth) {
    b <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(meta::metabias(m, method.bias = meth, k.min = 3)),
                  error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(b, "error") || is.null(b$pval))
      return(data.frame(test = meth, statistic = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, pval = NA_real_,
                        estimate = NA_real_, se_estimate = NA_real_,
                        error = if (inherits(b, "error")) conditionMessage(b) else "k 太少，無法計算",
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    data.frame(test = meth, statistic = first_num(b$statistic),
               df = if (is.null(b$df)) NA_real_ else first_num(b$df),
               pval = first_num(b$pval),
               estimate = first_num(b$estimate[1]), se_estimate = first_num(b$estimate[2]),
               error = NA_character_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  out <- rbind(one("Egger"), one("Begg"))
  out$k <- k
  out$warn_k_lt_10 <- k < 10
  out$warn_proportion <- s$type == "prop"
  out
}

.fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("p = NA")
  if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", p)
}

.fmt_est <- function(x, type, digits) {
  if (is.na(x)) return("NA")
  switch(type,
    prop = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%%"), 100 * x),
    rate = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), 1000 * x),
    mean = sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x))
}

#' 自動產生方法與結果段落
#' @return list(zh = 字串, en = 字串)
methods_text <- function(m, digits = 2) {
  s  <- attr(m, "settings")
  pt <- pooled_table(m)
  v  <- version_info()
  sig <- !is.na(pt$pval_Q) && pt$pval_Q < 0.05
  lv  <- round(100 * s$level)
  est <- function(x) .fmt_est(x, s$type, digits)
  unit_zh <- switch(s$type, prop = "合併比例", mean = "合併平均數", rate = "合併發生率（每 1,000 人時）")
  unit_en <- switch(s$type, prop = "The pooled proportion", mean = "The pooled mean",
                    rate = "The pooled incidence rate (per 1,000 person-time)")
  glmm <- s$method == "GLMM"
  model_zh <- if (glmm) {
    sprintf("以廣義線性混合模型（GLMM）合併%s", .sm_text[[s$sm]][["zh"]])
  } else {
    sprintf("以反變異數法合併%s", .sm_text[[s$sm]][["zh"]])
  }
  model_en <- if (glmm) {
    sprintf("%s were pooled using a generalized linear mixed model (GLMM)", .sm_text[[s$sm]][["en"]])
  } else {
    sprintf("%s were pooled using the inverse-variance method", .sm_text[[s$sm]][["en"]])
  }
  model_en <- paste0(toupper(substr(model_en, 1, 1)), substring(model_en, 2))
  if (s$model == "random") {
    re_zh <- sprintf("，採隨機效應模型，τ² 以 %s 估計", .tau_text[[s$method.tau]][["zh"]])
    re_en <- sprintf(" under a random-effects model, with τ² estimated by %s", .tau_text[[s$method.tau]][["en"]])
    if (s$hk) { re_zh <- paste0(re_zh, "，合併值信賴區間採 Knapp–Hartung 法")
                re_en <- paste0(re_en, "; confidence intervals for the pooled estimate used the Knapp–Hartung method") }
    if (s$prediction) { re_zh <- paste0(re_zh, sprintf("，並報告 %d%% 預測區間", lv))
                        re_en <- paste0(re_en, sprintf("; a %d%% prediction interval is reported", lv)) }
  } else {
    re_zh <- "，採固定（共同）效應模型"
    re_en <- " under a common-effect (fixed-effect) model"
  }
  zh_m <- sprintf(paste0(
    "本分析使用 R %s 的 meta 套件（%s 版）進行單組統合分析。%s%s。",
    "異質性以 Cochran's Q 檢定與 I² 評估。"),
    v$R_short, v$meta, model_zh, re_zh)
  en_m <- sprintf(paste0(
    "Single-arm meta-analysis was performed with the R package meta (version %s) in R %s. %s%s. ",
    "Heterogeneity was assessed with Cochran's Q test and the I² statistic."),
    v$meta, v$R_short, model_en, re_en)
  pi_zh <- if (!is.na(pt$pi_lower)) sprintf("，%d%% 預測區間 %s–%s", lv, est(pt$pi_lower), est(pt$pi_upper)) else ""
  pi_en <- if (!is.na(pt$pi_lower)) sprintf("; %d%% prediction interval, %s–%s", lv, est(pt$pi_lower), est(pt$pi_upper)) else ""
  zh_r <- sprintf("%s為 %s（%d%% CI %s–%s%s；k = %d）。I² = %.1f%%，Q = %.2f（df = %d，%s），異質性%s。",
    unit_zh, est(pt$estimate), lv, est(pt$lower), est(pt$upper), pi_zh, pt$k,
    pt$I2_pct, pt$Q, as.integer(pt$df_Q), .fmt_p(pt$pval_Q),
    if (sig) "達統計顯著" else "未達統計顯著")
  en_r <- sprintf("%s was %s (%d%% CI, %s–%s%s; k = %d). I² = %.1f%%; Q = %.2f (df = %d, %s), indicating %s heterogeneity.",
    unit_en, est(pt$estimate), lv, est(pt$lower), est(pt$upper), pi_en, pt$k,
    pt$I2_pct, pt$Q, as.integer(pt$df_Q), .fmt_p(pt$pval_Q),
    if (sig) "statistically significant" else "no statistically significant")
  list(zh = paste(zh_m, zh_r), en = paste(en_m, en_r))
}

# ---- 版本資訊 ---------------------------------------------------------------

version_info <- function() {
  pv <- function(p) if (requireNamespace(p, quietly = TRUE)) as.character(utils::packageVersion(p)) else NA_character_
  list(R = R.version.string, R_short = paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
       meta = pv("meta"), metafor = pv("metafor"),
       lme4 = pv("lme4"), core = CORE_VERSION)
}

# ---- 一次跑完 ---------------------------------------------------------------

#' 主入口：輸入 data.frame＋設定，回傳所有結果
analyze <- function(df, settings, digits_text = 2) {
  m <- run_meta(df, settings)
  list(meta = m, settings = settings,
       pooled = pooled_table(m), studies = study_table(m),
       subgroup = subgroup_table(m), loo = loo_table(m), bias = bias_table(m),
       text = methods_text(m, digits = digits_text),
       warnings = attr(m, "warnings"), versions = version_info())
}

#' 結果 CSV（長格式：section, 欄位）——寫出 UTF-8 with BOM，Excel 開啟不亂碼
results_csv <- function(res, file) {
  tag <- function(df, sec) if (is.null(df)) NULL else cbind(section = sec, df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  parts <- list(tag(res$pooled, "pooled"), tag(res$studies, "study"),
                tag(res$subgroup$groups, "subgroup"), tag(res$subgroup$between, "subgroup_between"),
                tag(res$loo, "leave_one_out"), tag(res$bias, "small_study_tests"))
  parts <- Filter(Negate(is.null), parts)
  cols <- unique(unlist(lapply(parts, names)))
  parts <- lapply(parts, function(p) { for (c in setdiff(cols, names(p))) p[[c]] <- NA; p[cols] })
  out <- signif_df(do.call(rbind, parts))
  con <- file(file, open = "wb"); on.exit(close(con))
  writeBin(as.raw(c(0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF)), con)
  utils::write.csv(out, con, row.names = FALSE, na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  invisible(out)
}

  if (s$type == "prop") args$pscale <- 100
  if (s$type == "rate") args$irscale <- 1000
  do.call(meta::forest, args)
}

#' 資料框 → 貼上框文字（Tab 分隔）。欄位內的換行改成空白；含雙引號或 Tab 的格以雙引號包住、內部的雙引號寫兩次（貼上框以 " 為引號字元），內容原樣保留
#' 逐欄轉成字串（as.character 保留 15 位有效數字），不經 apply() 的矩陣轉換（那會把數值欄格式化成同一寬度、少掉位數）
df_to_tsv <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df)) return("")
  # 含雙引號或 Tab 的格以 CSV 慣例寫成 "…"（內部的 " 寫成 ""）：貼上框解析後與原內容相同，上傳與直接貼上結果、訊息一致
  # 換行仍換成空格（貼上框不接受儲存格內換行）
  clean <- function(x) { x <- gsub("[\r\n]+", " ", trimws(as.character(x)))
    q <- grepl("[\"\t]", x); x[q] <- paste0("\"", gsub("\"", "\"\"", x[q], fixed = TRUE), "\""); x }
  cols <- lapply(df, clean)
  body <- if (nrow(df)) do.call(paste, c(unname(cols), sep = "\t")) else character()
  paste(c(paste(clean(names(df)), collapse = "\t"), body), collapse = "\n")
}

#' 事實標記：只看客觀條件（不設任何異常值門檻）。回傳每列的標記文字（沒有標記為 ""）
#' 平均數沒有 SD＝0 標記：輸入檢查要求標準差大於 0，SD＝0 的資料不會進到這張表
dcheck_flags <- function(df, type) {
  ft <- DC_FLAG_TEXT[[type]]
  sg_blank <- if ("subgroup" %in% names(df)) { s <- trimws(as.character(df$subgroup)); is.na(s) | s == "" } else rep(FALSE, nrow(df))

    prop = list(zero = df$events == 0, all = df$events == df$n, sg_blank = sg_blank),
    mean = list(sg_blank = sg_blank),
    rate = list(zero = df$events == 0, sg_blank = sg_blank))
  out <- character(nrow(df))
  for (k in names(hit)) { h <- which(hit[[k]] %in% TRUE); out[h] <- ifelse(nzchar(out[h]), paste0(out[h], "；", ft[[k]]), ft[[k]]) }
  out
}

#' 篩選、排序、分頁。query：研究名稱或子群組包含的文字（不分大小寫，逐字比對，不當正規表示式）
#' 文字欄不分大小寫、以 radix（位元組順序）排序，本機 R 與 webR 結果相同；同值保留原始順序
#' 輸入先驗證（瀏覽器端的值可能被竄改）：per 不是 10／20／50／all 就用 20；sort、query 只取第一個元素；page 不是數字就用 1
dcheck_view <- function(tab, sort_col = "no", desc = FALSE, query = "", per = "20", page = 1L) {
  first_chr <- function(x, default) { x <- tryCatch(as.character(unlist(x))[1], error = function(e) NA_character_); if (length(x) != 1 || is.na(x)) default else x }
  sort_col <- first_chr(sort_col, "no"); query <- first_chr(query, "")
  per <- first_chr(per, "20"); if (!per %in% DC_PER_PAGE) per <- "20"
  page <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(first_chr(page, "1"))); if (is.na(page)) page <- 1L
  desc <- isTRUE(as.logical(desc)[1])
  keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(tab))
  q <- tolower(trimws(query))
  if (nzchar(q)) {
    hay <- tolower(tab$study); if ("subgroup" %in% names(tab)) hay <- paste(hay, tolower(tab$subgroup), sep = "\r")
    keep <- grepl(q, hay, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  v <- tab[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!sort_col %in% names(v)) sort_col <- "no"
  key <- v[[sort_col]]
  o <- if (is.numeric(key)) order(key, v$no, decreasing = c(isTRUE(desc), FALSE), method = "radix")
       else order(tolower(as.character(key)), v$no, decreasing = c(isTRUE(desc), FALSE), method = "radix")
  v <- v[o, , drop = FALSE]
  total <- nrow(v)
  per_n <- if (identical(per, "all")) max(total, 1L) else max(1L, as.integer(per))
  pages <- as.integer(max(1, ceiling(total / per_n)))
  page <- as.integer(min(max(1L, as.integer(page)), pages))
  from <- if (total) (page - 1L) * per_n + 1L else 0L
  to <- min(total, page * per_n)
  list(rows = if (total) v[from:to, , drop = FALSE] else v, from = from, to = to, total = total, all = nrow(tab),
       page = page, pages = pages,
       info = if (total) sprintf("第 %d–%d 筆，共 %d 筆", from, to, total) else "共 0 筆（沒有符合的研究）")
}

               vapply(data_cols, function(cn) { x <- rows[[cn]][i]; if (is.numeric(x)) num(x) else as.character(x) }, ""))
    tags$tr(class = if (nzchar(rows$flag[i])) "hdh-dc-flag", lapply(seq_along(cells), function(j) tags$td(class = if (is_num[j]) "num", cells[j])))
  })
  div(class = "hdh-scroll", tags$table(class = "hdh-table hdh-dc-table", tags$thead(tags$tr(th)), tags$tbody(trs)))
}

#' 方法段落補強（core 的 methods_text 之後）：meta 版本改成正式版號；有次群組分析時補一句
fix_methods_text <- function(r) {
  vi <- version_info(); mv <- pkg_ver("meta")
  zh <- r$text$zh; en <- r$text$en
  if (!is.na(mv)) {
    zh <- sub(sprintf("（%s 版）", vi$meta), sprintf("（%s 版）", mv), zh, fixed = TRUE)
    en <- sub(sprintf("(version %s)", vi$meta), sprintf("(version %s)", mv), en, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  # 中文空白整理只套用在工具產生的文字；之後才接上次群組句（次群組名稱是使用者輸入，原樣保留）
  zh <- gsub("以 (?=[^\\x{01}-\\x{7f}])", "以", zh, perl = TRUE)          # 「以 限制最大概似法」→ 中文前不留空白
  zh <- gsub("(?<=[^\\x{01}-\\x{7f}]) 估計", "估計", zh, perl = TRUE)    # 「（REML） 估計」→ 中文與全形符號後不留空白
  zh <- gsub("合併(?=[A-Za-z])", "合併 ", zh, perl = TRUE)        # 「合併logit」→「合併 logit」
  if (!is.null(r$subgroup)) {
    g <- r$subgroup$groups; b <- r$subgroup$between
    zh <- paste0(zh, sprintf(" 次群組分析依 subgroup 欄位分為 %d 組（%s），組間差異以 Q 檢定評估：Q = %.2f（df = %d，%s）。",
                             nrow(g), paste(g$subgroup, collapse = "、"), b$Q_between, as.integer(b$df_between), .fmt_p(b$pval_between)))
    en <- paste0(en, sprintf(" A subgroup analysis by the subgroup variable (%d groups: %s) was performed; differences between subgroups were assessed with the Q test (Q = %.2f, df = %d, %s).",
                             nrow(g), paste(g$subgroup, collapse = ", "), b$Q_between, as.integer(b$df_between), .fmt_p(b$pval_between)))
  }
  r$text <- list(zh = zh, en = en)
  r
}

#' 貼上文字 → 全部欄位保留為「原始字串」（不讓 read.table 自動把 0x10、1e400 轉成 16、Inf）
#' 分隔符號（貼上與上傳共用 record_sep）：split_records 之後的第一列（欄位名稱）有 Tab 用 Tab，否則用逗號
record_sep <- function(sr) if (length(sr$recs) && grepl("\t", sr$recs[1], fixed = TRUE)) "\t" else ","
read_text_chr <- function(text, sep = NULL) {
  text <- sub("\n+$", "", gsub("\r\n?", "\n", text))
  if (!nzchar(trimws(text))) stop("貼上的內容是空的")
  if (is.null(sep)) sep <- record_sep(split_records(text))
  utils::read.table(text = text, header = TRUE, sep = sep, quote = "\"", colClasses = "character",
                    na.strings = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE,
                    strip.white = TRUE, comment.char = "")
}

INVISIBLE_RE <- "[\u00a0\u00ad\u2000-\u200d\u202f\u205f\u2060\u3000\ufeff]"   # R 的 \u 跳脫：字串為 UTF-8，PCRE 以 UTF 模式比對
#' 數字解析：只接受十進位、科學記號、千分位逗號（第一組 1–3 位且不以 0 開頭，其後每 3 位一組）
#' 回傳 list(x = 數值（不合格為 NA）, ok, hex（十六進位）, too_big（超出範圍）, dcomma（疑似以逗號當小數點）)
parse_num <- function(s) {
  dec <- "^[+-]?([1-9]\\d{0,2}(,\\d{3})+|\\d+)?(\\.\\d+)?([eE][+-]?\\d+)?$"
  has_digit <- grepl("^[+-]?(\\d|\\.\\d)", s)
  ok <- grepl(dec, s, perl = TRUE) & has_digit
  x <- rep(NA_real_, length(s))
  x[ok] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", s[ok], fixed = TRUE)))
  too_big <- ok & !is.finite(x)
  x[too_big] <- NA_real_
  list(x = x, ok = ok & !too_big, hex = grepl("^[+-]?0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+$", s), too_big = too_big,
       dcomma = !ok & grepl("^[+-]?\\d+,\\d+$", s))
}

#' 依引號解析切分「列」（貼上與上傳共用）：雙引號成對時，引號內的換行屬於同一列
#' 回傳 list(recs = 各列文字（已去掉空白列）, line = 各列在原文的起始行號, n_lines = 跨了幾行, n_blank = 略過的空白列數)
#' 空白列：只有空白（含不換行空白、換頁等）、逗號或 Tab 的列；結尾的空白列不計入略過數
split_records <- function(txt) {
  lines <- strsplit(gsub("\r\n?", "\n", txt), "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (!length(lines)) return(list(recs = character(), line = integer(), n_lines = integer(), n_blank = 0L))
  q <- lengths(regmatches(lines, gregexpr("\"", lines, fixed = TRUE)))
  closed <- cumsum(q) %% 2 == 0                                   # 這一行結束時，引號是否成對
  rid <- c(1L, 1L + cumsum(closed)[-length(lines)])               # 引號沒成對就併入下一行
  recs <- vapply(split(lines, rid), paste, "", collapse = "\n", USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  start <- as.integer(vapply(split(seq_along(lines), rid), min, 0L))
  nl <- as.integer(lengths(split(lines, rid)))
  blank <- !grepl("[^[:space:], ]", recs)
  last <- if (any(!blank)) max(which(!blank)) else 0L
  list(recs = recs[!blank], line = start[!blank], n_lines = nl[!blank], n_blank = sum(blank[seq_len(last)]))
}

#' 一列有幾格（引號內的分隔符號不算）
n_fields_q <- function(recs, sep) {
  stripped <- gsub("\"[^\"]*(?:\"\"[^\"]*)*\"", "", recs, perl = TRUE)
  lengths(regmatches(stripped, gregexpr(sep, stripped, fixed = TRUE))) + 1L
}

#' 列的形狀檢查（貼上與上傳共用，訊息相同）：引號位置、儲存格內換行、格數與欄位名稱數不同
#' src：「貼上內容」或「檔案」，訊息同時寫出資料列號與原文行號，避免「第 1 列」與「第一列」混淆
#' 列的說法（形狀錯誤與數值錯誤共用）：第 j 筆紀錄（1 = 欄位名稱那一列）→「資料第 N 列（貼上內容／檔案第 M 行）」
row_label <- function(sr, j, src) if (j == 1) sprintf("欄位名稱那一列（%s第 %d 行）", src, sr$line[1]) else
  sprintf("資料第 %d 列（%s第 %d 行）", sr$line[j] - sr$line[1], src, sr$line[j])
row_shape_errors <- function(sr, sep, src) {
  sepre <- if (sep == "\t") "\\t" else ","
  where <- function(j) row_label(sr, j, src)
  # 合法的引號：整格以引號包住（格子開頭到格子結尾）；去掉之後若還有引號，就是位置不對或不成對
  rest <- gsub(sprintf("(^|%s)\"[^\"]*(?:\"\"[^\"]*)*\"(?=%s|$)", sepre, sepre), "\\1", sr$recs, perl = TRUE)
  bad_q <- which(grepl("\"", rest, fixed = TRUE))
  if (length(bad_q))
    return(sprintf("%s有不成對或位置不對的雙引號（\"）。研究名稱含有雙引號時，請把整格用雙引號包住，並把內部的雙引號寫成兩個（例如 \"A \"\"x\"\" 2020\"），或改用單引號。", vapply(bad_q, where, "")))
  multi <- which(sr$n_lines > 1)
  if (length(multi))
    return(sprintf("%s的儲存格內有換行（從 Excel 複製時，這種儲存格會被加上雙引號並跨成好幾行）。請先刪除儲存格內的換行再複製。",
                   vapply(multi, where, "")))
  nf <- n_fields_q(sr$recs, sep)
  more <- which(nf > nf[1]); less <- which(nf < nf[1])
  c(sprintf("%s比欄位名稱多了 %d 格：研究名稱裡含有%s，或右邊多了一欄。", vapply(more, where, ""), nf[more] - nf[1],
            if (sep == "\t") " Tab" else "逗號"),
    sprintf("%s比欄位名稱少了 %d 格：可能有儲存格沒填。", vapply(less, where, ""), nf[1] - nf[less]))
}

#' 研究名稱中，瀏覽器版繪圖字型可能畫不出來的字：拉丁、希臘、斯拉夫字母與常用標點以外的字（中日韓、泰文、阿拉伯文等）
GLYPH_OK <- rbind(c(0x0000, 0x036F),   # 拉丁字母（含擴充、IPA、附加符號）
                  c(0x0370, 0x03FF),   # 希臘
                  c(0x0400, 0x052F),   # 斯拉夫
                  c(0x1E00, 0x1FFF),   # 拉丁擴充附加、希臘擴充
                  c(0x2000, 0x206F),   # 一般標點（破折號、引號等）
                  c(0x20A0, 0x20CF))   # 貨幣符號
glyph_risk <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    u <- utf8ToInt(enc2utf8(s))
    any(!vapply(u, function(cp) any(cp >= GLYPH_OK[, 1] & cp <= GLYPH_OK[, 2]), logical(1)))
  }, logical(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

check_input <- function(txt, type, use_sg) {
  out <- list(df = NULL, errs = character(), warns = character(), ok = FALSE, k = 0L, has_sg = FALSE)
  if (is.null(txt)) return(out)
  if (nchar(txt, type = "chars") > LIMITS$max_chars) {    # 先量長度，再做任何字串處理
    out$errs <- sprintf("貼上的內容太長（超過 %s 字元）。統合分析只需要每篇研究一列的彙總數字。",
                        format(LIMITS$max_chars, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE))
    return(out)
  }
  if (!grepl("[^[:space:]]", txt)) return(out)
  sr <- split_records(txt)
  if (!length(sr$recs)) return(out)                # 只有空白、逗號或 Tab：視同沒有資料
  rl <- function(i) row_label(sr, i + 1, "貼上內容")  # 數值錯誤與形狀錯誤用同一種列號說法
  if (sr$n_blank > 0) out$warns <- c(out$warns, sprintf("已略過 %d 列空白列。", sr$n_blank))
  need <- INPUT_COLS[[type]]
  one_col <- "資料只讀到一欄。請從 Excel 直接複製儲存格後貼上，不要先貼到 Word 或記事本。"
  sep <- record_sep(sr)   # 依第一列（欄位名稱）決定，與上傳共用
  # 引號與格數：貼上框以 " 為引號字元，位置不對、跨行或格數不同時整列會讀錯，先指出真正原因
  if (n_fields_q(sr$recs[1], sep) < 2) { out$errs <- one_col; return(out) }
  shape <- row_shape_errors(sr, sep, "貼上內容")
  if (length(shape)) { out$errs <- shape; return(out) }
  lines <- sr$recs
  raw <- tryCatch(read_text_chr(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"), sep = sep), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(raw) || ncol(raw) < 2) { out$errs <- one_col; return(out) }
  nm <- tolower(trimws(names(raw)))
  if (any(!is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nm)))) && !any(need %in% nm)) {
    out$errs <- sprintf("第一列看起來是資料，不是欄位名稱。請在最上面加一列欄位名稱：%s。", paste(need, collapse = "、"))
    return(out)
  }
  if (!any(need %in% nm) && any(vapply(nm, function(s) any(utf8ToInt(s) > 127), logical(1)))) {
    out$errs <- sprintf("第一列的欄位名稱要用英文：%s。目前讀到的是「%s」，請把第一列改成上面的英文欄位名稱。",
                        paste(need, collapse = "、"), paste(names(raw), collapse = "、"))
    return(out)
  }
  dup_nm <- unique(nm[duplicated(nm) & nzchar(nm)])       # 空白欄名（例如結尾多選了空欄）不算重複
  if (length(dup_nm)) {
    out$errs <- sprintf("欄位「%s」出現 %d 次。每個欄位名稱只能出現一次。", dup_nm,
                        vapply(dup_nm, function(v) sum(nm == v), integer(1)))
    return(out)
  }
  names(raw) <- nm
  miss <- setdiff(need, nm)
  if (length(miss)) {
    out$errs <- sprintf("找不到欄位「%s」。%s需要這些欄位：%s。請確認第一列是欄位名稱，而且拼字相同。",
                        miss, TYPE_NAME[[type]], paste(need, collapse = "、"))
    return(out)
  }
  for (v in setdiff(nm[nzchar(nm)], c(need, "subgroup"))) {
    if (grepl(PII_PATTERN, v, ignore.case = TRUE))
      out$warns <- c(out$warns, sprintf("資料裡有欄位「%s」，看起來可能是個人資料。本工具只需要每篇研究的彙總數字，請確認沒有貼上個別病人的資料。", v))
    out$warns <- c(out$warns, sprintf("欄位「%s」不會用到，已忽略。", v))
  }
  errs <- character()
  st <- trimws(as.character(raw$study)); st[is.na(st)] <- ""
  for (i in which(st == "")) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s缺少研究名稱。請在 study 欄填入名稱，例如「Wang 2020」。", rl(i)))
  num <- list()
  for (v in setdiff(need, "study")) {
    s <- trimws(as.character(raw[[v]])); s[is.na(s)] <- ""
    pn <- parse_num(s)
    for (i in which(s == "")) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的「%s」是空的。每篇研究的每一欄都要有數字。", rl(i), v))
    for (i in which(pn$hex)) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的「%s」看起來是十六進位數字（目前是「%s」）。本工具只接受一般的十進位數字，請改寫，例如 0x10 應寫成 16。", rl(i), v, s[i]))
    for (i in which(pn$dcomma)) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的「%s」看起來用逗號當小數點（目前是「%s」）。小數點請用「.」，例如 0.5。", rl(i), v, s[i]))
    for (i in which(pn$too_big)) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的「%s」數值太大（目前是「%s」），超出可計算的範圍。", rl(i), v, s[i]))
    inv <- grepl(INVISIBLE_RE, s, perl = TRUE)          # 不換行空白、軟連字號、零寬字元、全形空白等（trimws 去不掉）
    only_inv <- inv & !nzchar(gsub(paste0(INVISIBLE_RE, "|[[:space:]]"), "", s, perl = TRUE))
    for (i in which(only_inv)) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的「%s」這格是空的（只有看不見的空白字元）。每篇研究的每一欄都要有數字。", rl(i), v))
    inv <- inv & !only_inv
    for (i in which(s != "" & !pn$ok & inv)) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的「%s」%s有看不見的空白字元（例如從網頁表格複製時帶進來的不換行空白），請刪除後再試。", rl(i), v,
                                                                       if (grepl(paste0(INVISIBLE_RE, "+$"), s[i], perl = TRUE)) "後面" else if (grepl(paste0("^", INVISIBLE_RE), s[i], perl = TRUE)) "前面" else "中間"))
    for (i in which(s != "" & !pn$ok & !pn$hex & !pn$too_big & !pn$dcomma & !inv & !only_inv)) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的「%s」不是數字（目前是「%s」）。請改成數字，不要加單位或 %% 符號。", rl(i), v, s[i]))
    num[[v]] <- pn$x
  }
  ok_row <- function(v) !is.na(num[[v]])
  if ("n" %in% need) for (i in which(ok_row("n") & (num$n <= 0 | num$n != round(num$n))))
    errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的人數必須是大於 0 的整數（目前是「%s」）。", rl(i), raw$n[i]))
  if ("events" %in% need) for (i in which(ok_row("events") & (num$events < 0 | num$events != round(num$events))))
    errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的事件數必須是 0 或正整數（目前是「%s」）。", rl(i), raw$events[i]))
  # 極大值：meta 對比例／發生率的各研究信賴區間用精確法，計數超過 1,000 萬時記憶體與時間暴增（n = 1e9 實測 >300 秒）
  cap <- LIMITS$max_count
  cap_txt <- format(cap, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
  if (type == "prop") for (i in which(ok_row("n") & num$n > cap))
    errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的人數（%s）超過本工具上限 %s。", rl(i), raw$n[i], cap_txt))
  if (type == "rate") for (i in which(ok_row("events") & num$events > cap))
    errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的事件數（%s）超過本工具上限 %s。", rl(i), raw$events[i], cap_txt))
  if (type == "prop") for (i in which(ok_row("events") & ok_row("n") & num$events > num$n))
    errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的事件數（%s）大於總人數（%s）。請檢查兩欄是否放反。", rl(i), raw$events[i], raw$n[i]))
  if (type == "mean") for (i in which(ok_row("sd") & num$sd <= 0))
    errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的標準差必須大於 0（目前是「%s」）。", rl(i), raw$sd[i]))
  if (type == "rate") for (i in which(ok_row("time") & num$time <= 0))
    errs <- c(errs, sprintf("%s的觀察人時必須大於 0（目前是「%s」）。", rl(i), raw$time[i]))
  k <- nrow(raw)
  if (k < 2) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("目前僅 %d 篇研究。統合分析至少需要 2 篇。", k))
  if (k > LIMITS$max_rows) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("資料有 %d 列，超過上限 %d 列。請確認每篇研究只占一列。", k, LIMITS$max_rows))
  dup <- table(st[st != ""]); dup <- dup[dup > 1]
  # W02：core 要求研究名稱唯一，重複時無法分析，故以紅色顯示
  for (nmd in names(dup)) errs <- c(errs, sprintf("研究名稱「%s」出現 %d 次。若是不同研究，請加上年份或 a、b 區分。", nmd, dup[[nmd]]))
  out$k <- k; out$rowlab <- vapply(seq_len(k), rl, "")
  out$has_sg <- "subgroup" %in% nm && any(nzchar(trimws(as.character(raw$subgroup))))
  if (length(errs)) { out$errs <- errs; return(out) }
  df <- standardize_input(raw, type)
  df_all <- df                                     # 讀入的完整資料（含 subgroup，即使沒勾選或有空白）：左欄摘要與資料檢查表用
  if (!(use_sg && out$has_sg)) df$subgroup <- NULL
  if (!is.null(df$subgroup)) {
    tb <- table(df$subgroup)
    for (g in names(tb)[tb == 1 & nzchar(names(tb))]) out$warns <- c(out$warns, sprintf("次群組「%s」僅 1 篇研究，該組無法估計研究間變異。", g))
  }
  if (k == 2) out$warns <- c(out$warns, "研究僅 2 篇。研究間變異與預測區間的估計會很不穩定，請保守解讀。")
  cv <- validate_input(df, ma_settings(type))   # core 把關
  if (length(cv)) { out$errs <- cv; return(out) }
  out$df <- df; out$df_all <- df_all; out$ok <- TRUE
  out
}

#' 訊息太多時只顯示前 5 則（錯誤與提醒共用）
limit_msgs <- function(x, more = "另有 %d 個問題，請先修正以上幾項。") {
  if (length(x) <= 5) return(x)
  c(x[1:5], sprintf(more, length(x) - 5))
}
limit_errs <- function(errs) limit_msgs(errs)
limit_warns <- function(w) limit_msgs(w, "另有 %d 則提醒。")

LIMITS <- list(max_rows = 120L, max_bytes = 2L * 1024L^2, max_chars = 500000L, timeout_s = 300, max_count = 1e7)   # max_rows：瀏覽器實測預設設定 120 篇約 36 秒、140 篇約 57 秒、150 篇約 68 秒

#' S3 CSV 公式注入：以 = + - @ | Tab CR 開頭的文字，前面加 '
csv_safe <- function(x) {
  if (!is.character(x)) return(x)
  i <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^[-=+@|\t\r]", x)
  x[i] <- paste0("'", x[i])
  x
}

#' 對結果中所有文字欄位做 csv_safe（數值欄不動）
sanitize_res <- function(r) {
  f <- function(df) { if (is.null(df)) return(df); df[] <- lapply(df, csv_safe); df }
  r$pooled <- f(r$pooled); r$studies <- f(r$studies); r$loo <- f(r$loo); r$bias <- f(r$bias)
  if (!is.null(r$subgroup)) { r$subgroup$groups <- f(r$subgroup$groups); r$subgroup$between <- f(r$subgroup$between) }
  r
}

#' 結果 CSV 的單位說明（每一列一個 unit 欄）：CSV 的數值是 meta 的原始尺度，與畫面不同
CSV_UNIT <- c(
  prop = "比例（0 到 1）。畫面上的 % = 此值 × 100",
  rate = "每人時的發生率（time 欄的單位）。畫面上的「每 1,000 人時」= 此值 × 1,000",
  mean = "與輸入的平均數相同單位")
CSV_UNIT_OTHER <- "τ²、I²（%）、Q、df、p、檢定統計量與 TE、seTE（轉換尺度）不換算"
P_COLS <- c("pval_Q", "pval_Q_LRT", "pval", "pval_between")

#' 下載用 CSV：一律經過 sanitize_res 再交給 core 的 results_csv（取 10 位有效數字），
#' 之後加上單位欄；p 值小於 R 的機器精度（約 2.2e-16）時寫成「< 2.2e-16」，不寫 0
write_results_csv <- function(r, file) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv"); on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  out <- results_csv(sanitize_res(r), tmp)
  eps <- .Machine$double.eps
  for (pc in intersect(P_COLS, names(out))) {
    v <- out[[pc]]
    out[[pc]] <- ifelse(is.na(v), NA_character_, ifelse(v < eps, sprintf("< %.1e", eps), format(v, digits = 10, trim = TRUE)))
  }
  tp <- r$type %||% r$settings$type
  est_sec <- out$section %in% c("pooled", "study", "subgroup", "leave_one_out")
  out$unit <- ifelse(est_sec, paste0("estimate／lower／upper／pi_lower／pi_upper：", CSV_UNIT[[tp]], "；", CSV_UNIT_OTHER),
                     CSV_UNIT_OTHER)
  # 事件數為 0 的研究：meta 對 estimate 加 0.5 連續性校正（未校正的值為 0，森林圖顯示的就是未校正的 0）
  out$note <- NA_character_
  ev <- r$meta$event
  if (!is.null(ev)) {
    i_st <- which(out$section == "study")
    z <- i_st[ev == 0 & as.numeric(out$estimate[i_st]) > 0]
    out$note[z] <- "事件數為 0：estimate 是加 0.5 連續性校正後的值；未校正的值為 0（森林圖顯示未校正的 0）"
  }
  con <- file(file, open = "wb"); on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  writeBin(as.raw(c(0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF)), con)
  utils::write.csv(out, con, row.names = FALSE, na = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  invisible(out)
}
