#' S4 上傳檢查：副檔名、大小、編碼、列數；回傳 list(ok, df | err)
check_upload <- function(path, name, size = file.size(path)) {
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(name %||% ""))
  if (!ext %in% c("csv", "tsv"))
    return(list(ok = FALSE, err = "只接受 .csv 或 .tsv 檔。若是 Excel 檔，請先另存成「CSV UTF-8（逗號分隔）」再上傳。"))
  if (is.na(size) || size <= 0) return(list(ok = FALSE, err = MSG_E15))
  if (size > LIMITS$max_bytes)
    return(list(ok = FALSE, err = sprintf("檔案太大（%.1f MB），上限為 %d MB。統合分析只需要每篇研究一列的彙總數字。",
                                          size / 1024^2, LIMITS$max_bytes %/% 1024^2)))
  rawb <- tryCatch(readBin(path, "raw", size), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(rawb) || length(rawb) == 0) return(list(ok = FALSE, err = MSG_E15))
  if (length(rawb) >= 3 && all(rawb[1:3] == as.raw(c(0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF)))) rawb <- rawb[-(1:3)]
  if (any(rawb == as.raw(0))) return(list(ok = FALSE, err = MSG_E15))
  txt <- rawToChar(rawb); Encoding(txt) <- "UTF-8"
  if (!validUTF8(txt)) return(list(ok = FALSE, err = MSG_E16))
  # 依引號解析切分列，逐列比對格數（read.table 的 fill = TRUE 會把多出來的格子塞進下一欄，造成欄位錯位）；訊息與貼上路徑相同
  sr <- split_records(txt)
  sep <- record_sep(sr)   # 與貼上相同：依切分後的第一列判斷（開頭的空白列不影響；副檔名不影響）
  if (!length(sr$recs)) return(list(ok = FALSE, err = MSG_E15))
  if (n_fields_q(sr$recs[1], sep) < 2) return(list(ok = FALSE, err = MSG_UP_ONE_COL))   # 例如分號分隔：上傳用的說法（貼上框維持貼上用的說法）
  shape <- row_shape_errors(sr, sep, "檔案")
  if (length(shape)) return(list(ok = FALSE, err = paste(limit_errs(shape), collapse = " ")))
  # 讀已過濾空白列的內容（只有逗號的空白列不會被讀成一列空資料）
  d <- tryCatch(utils::read.table(text = paste(sr$recs, collapse = "\n"), sep = sep, header = TRUE, quote = "\"", comment.char = "",
                                  colClasses = "character", check.names = FALSE,
                                  strip.white = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8"),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(d) || ncol(d) < 1) return(list(ok = FALSE, err = MSG_E15))
  if (nrow(d) > LIMITS$max_rows)
    return(list(ok = FALSE, err = sprintf("資料有 %d 列，超過上限 %d 列。請確認每篇研究只占一列。", nrow(d), LIMITS$max_rows)))
  # 雙引號原樣保留：放進貼上框時以雙引號包住、內部的雙引號寫兩次（df_to_tsv），內容與直接貼上相同
  list(ok = TRUE, df = d)
}

#' S6 逾時：elapsed 超過 seconds 即中止（R 層可中斷處才有效；編譯碼迴圈內無法中斷）
run_with_timeout <- function(expr, seconds = LIMITS$timeout_s) {
  setTimeLimit(elapsed = seconds, transient = TRUE)
  on.exit(setTimeLimit(elapsed = Inf), add = TRUE)
  expr
}

#' 判斷一則錯誤訊息是否為逾時（逾時文字的比對只寫在這裡）
is_timeout_msg <- function(msg) any(grepl("time limit|elapsed time", msg, ignore.case = TRUE))

#' 分段分析：步驟與 core::analyze 完全相同（run_meta → pooled_table → study_table → subgroup_table → loo_table →
#' bias_table → methods_text），差別只在每一段開始前檢查已用時間，並以「剩餘秒數」重新設定時間上限。
#' 這樣即使某一段的編譯碼無法被中斷，下一段也不會開始。不改 core.R 的任何計算。
#' leave-one-out 會重新擬合 k 次；meta 內部以 try() 包住每次擬合，時間上限的中斷若落在 try() 內會被收下、不再觸發，
#' 這一段就會跑完才停。因此開始前先估計所需時間，剩餘時間不到估計值的 1.2 倍時，直接判定逾時、不開始這一段。
#' 估計值 = k × 單次配適耗時。單次配適以「不含次群組」的資料、在主分析之後（套件已載入、已暖身）另外計時兩次取較小者：
#'   - 主分析含次群組時要多配適每一組，拿它當基準會高估 4–6 倍；leave-one-out 每次只重配整體模型
#'   - 第一次執行含載入與暖身時間；取兩次的較小者，排除偶發的延遲
#'   本機實測 leave-one-out 實耗約為估計值的 0.94–1.15 倍（反變異數、GLMM；有／無次群組；k = 46、120）
#' 計時用的兩次配適只量時間，結果不使用；耗時約為 leave-one-out 的 2／k。
hdh_timeout <- function(estimated = FALSE)   # 本工具自己判定的逾時（含預估提早停止）；以類別判斷，不靠訊息文字
  structure(class = c("hdh_timeout", "error", "condition"),
            list(message = if (estimated %in% TRUE) "預估逾時" else "已超過時間上限", call = NULL, estimated = estimated))
analyze_steps <- function(df, settings, digits_text = 2, seconds = Inf) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  step <- function(f, need = 0) {
    left <- seconds - as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
    if (left <= 0) stop(hdh_timeout())
    if (need * 1.2 > left) stop(hdh_timeout(estimated = TRUE))
    run_with_timeout(f(), left)
  }
  m <- step(function() run_meta(df, settings))
  t_fit <- if (is.finite(seconds)) step(function() {   # 沒有時間上限時不必預估（也不多做計時配適）
    d1 <- df; d1$subgroup <- NULL
    min(vapply(1:2, function(i) { t1 <- Sys.time(); run_meta(d1, settings); as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t1, units = "secs")) }, 0))
  }) else 0
  pooled   <- step(function() pooled_table(m))
  studies  <- step(function() study_table(m))
  subgroup <- step(function() subgroup_table(m))
  loo      <- step(function() loo_table(m), need = (m$k %||% 0) * t_fit)
  bias     <- step(function() bias_table(m))
  text     <- step(function() methods_text(m, digits = digits_text))
  list(meta = m, settings = settings, pooled = pooled, studies = studies, subgroup = subgroup, loo = loo, bias = bias,
       text = text, warnings = attr(m, "warnings"), versions = version_info())
}

#' S6 安全執行分析：任何錯誤都轉成中文訊息，不讓 app 崩潰
#' 逾時（timed_out）一律視為失敗，不採用這次的結果。四種來源合成一個旗標：
#'   1) 某一段被時間上限中斷（R 的 setTimeLimit 錯誤，或本工具在段與段之間判定的 hdh_timeout）；
#'      失敗且實際耗時已達上限者一律視為逾時，不看訊息文字（套件可能把逾時錯誤改寫成別的訊息）；
#'   2) 逾時錯誤被 meta／metafor 內部的 try() 收下、記在檢定欄位（結果可能不完整）；
#'   3) 全部算完但實際耗時超過上限（webR 內編譯碼無法中斷時會發生）；
#'   4) leave-one-out 開始前預估剩餘時間不夠，提早停止（hdh_timeout，estimated = TRUE）
safe_analyze <- function(df, settings, digits_text = 2, seconds = LIMITS$timeout_s) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  out <- tryCatch(analyze_steps(df, settings, digits_text = digits_text, seconds = seconds), error = function(e) e)
  failed <- inherits(out, "error")
  el <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
  # 容許 0.05 秒：setTimeLimit 與這裡的 Sys.time() 計時來源不同，實測邊界會差 1–15 毫秒
  timed_out <- inherits(out, "hdh_timeout") || (failed && (el >= seconds - 0.05 || is_timeout_msg(conditionMessage(out)))) ||
    (!failed && (as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs")) > seconds || is_timeout_msg(out$bias$error %||% character())))
  if (timed_out) {
    tip <- if (identical(settings$method, "GLMM")) "請改用反變異數法（效果量選 GLMM 以外的轉換），或減少研究數後再試。"
           else "請減少研究數後再試。"
    if (inherits(out, "hdh_timeout") && isTRUE(out$estimated))   # 預估提早停止：說明是哪一段、為什麼久
      return(list(ok = FALSE, code = "E21", msg = sprintf(paste0(
        "預估計算會超過 %s 秒，已停止。最花時間的是「逐篇剔除」分析：每篇研究都要拿掉後重算一次，",
        "研究數愈多、或各研究的人數愈大，每次重算愈久。%s"), format(seconds), tip)))
    return(list(ok = FALSE, code = "E21", msg = sprintf("計算超過 %s 秒仍未完成，已停止。%s", format(seconds), tip)))
  }
  if (failed) return(list(ok = FALSE, code = "E17", msg = paste0(
    "分析沒有完成。請檢查資料是否有不合理的數值，或到「分析設定」換一種設定再試。系統訊息：", conditionMessage(out))))
  list(ok = TRUE, res = fix_methods_text(out))
}

# ---- 圖：投稿用（無浮水印）／分享用（不透明浮水印）；PNG／PDF ----------------------
FIG <- list(scale = PNG_SCALE, css_w = PNG_CSS_W, gap_css = 8, wm_frac = 0.12, wm_margin = 0.025,
            wm_file = "assets/watermark_opaque_20261115_CSX.png", wm_w0 = 805, wm_h0 = 889,
            funnel_h_css = 560)

forest_args <- function(m, type, digits) {
  fs <- setNames(as.list(rep(FOREST_FS, 20)),
    c("fontsize", "fs.heading", "fs.common", "fs.random", "fs.predict", "fs.common.labels",
      "fs.random.labels", "fs.predict.labels", "fs.study", "fs.study.labels", "fs.hetstat",
      "fs.test.overall", "fs.test.subgroup", "fs.test.effect.subgroup", "fs.addline", "fs.axis",
      "fs.smlab", "fs.xlab", "fs.lr", "fs.details"))
  a <- c(list(m, digits = digits, prediction = isTRUE(m$prediction),
              leftcols = "studlab", leftlabs = "Study", rightcols = c("effect", "ci"),
              rightlabs = c(switch(type, prop = "Prop. (%)", rate = "Rate per 1000", mean = "Mean"), "95% CI"),
              smlab = "", col.diamond = "#B82226", col.predict = "#B82226",
              addrows.below.overall = 4, JAMA.pval = TRUE, details = FALSE), fs)
  if (!is.null(m$subgroup)) a$subgroup.hetstat <- FALSE
  if (type == "prop") a$pscale <- 100
  if (type == "rate") a$irscale <- 1000
  a
}

#' 圖的內容高度（CSS px）：森林圖由 forest() 回報的 figheight 決定，漏斗圖固定
fig_height_css <- function(kind, m, type, digits) {
  if (kind == "funnel") return(FIG$funnel_h_css)
  grDevices::pdf(NULL); on.exit(grDevices::dev.off())
  r <- do.call(meta::forest, forest_args(m, type, digits))
  as.integer(ceiling((r$figheight$total_height + 0.3) * 72))
}

#' 在目前裝置的上方 top_frac 區域畫圖（下方留白給浮水印）
draw_content <- function(kind, m, type, digits, top_frac = 1) {
  if (kind == "forest") {
    grid::grid.newpage()
    grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(y = 1, height = top_frac, just = "top"))
    do.call(meta::forest, c(forest_args(m, type, digits), list(new = FALSE)))
    grid::popViewport()
  } else {
    op <- graphics::par(fig = c(0, 1, 1 - top_frac, 1), cex = FOREST_FS / 12, mar = c(5, 5, 2, 2))
    on.exit(graphics::par(op))
    meta::funnel(m)
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

wm_geometry <- function(W, H) {
  ww <- round(W * FIG$wm_frac); wh <- round(ww * FIG$wm_h0 / FIG$wm_w0); mg <- round(W * FIG$wm_margin)
  list(ww = ww, wh = wh, m = mg, x0 = W - mg - ww, y0 = H - mg - wh, g = FIG$gap_css * FIG$scale)
}

open_device <- function(file, format, total_css) {
  if (format == "png")
    grDevices::png(file, width = FIG$css_w * FIG$scale, height = total_css * FIG$scale,
                   res = 72 * FIG$scale, bg = "white")
  else grDevices::pdf(file, width = FIG$css_w / 72, height = total_css / 72, bg = "white", useDingbats = FALSE)
}

#' 非白色像素矩陣（列 × 欄，TRUE＝圖面內容）
#' 以 native 格式讀入（每像素 1 個整數），研究數多、圖很長時記憶體約為 3 通道倍精度的 1/6
nonwhite_px <- function(png_file) {
  a <- png::readPNG(png_file, native = TRUE)
  matrix(as.integer(a) != -1L, nrow = attr(a, "dim")[1], ncol = attr(a, "dim")[2], byrow = TRUE)   # 依列存放； 不透明白色 = 0xFFFFFFFF = -1L
}

#' 依浮水印配置規則逐張計算下緣加長量
plan_figure <- function(kind, m, type, digits) {
  H_css <- fig_height_css(kind, m, type, digits)
  W <- FIG$css_w * FIG$scale; H <- H_css * FIG$scale
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png"); on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  open_device(tmp, "png", H_css); draw_content(kind, m, type, digits); grDevices::dev.off()
  nw <- nonwhite_px(tmp)
  geo <- wm_geometry(W, H)
  cols <- max(1, geo$x0 - geo$g + 1):W
  rows <- which(rowSums(nw[, cols, drop = FALSE]) > 0)
  r <- if (length(rows)) max(rows) - 1 else -1                 # 0-based 最低內容列
  ext_px <- max(0, r + 1 + geo$g - geo$y0)
  ext_css <- as.integer(ceiling(ext_px / FIG$scale))
  list(kind = kind, H_css = H_css, ext_css = ext_css, total_css = H_css + ext_css,
       geo = wm_geometry(W, (H_css + ext_css) * FIG$scale))
}

#' 輸出圖檔；watermark = TRUE 為分享用（不透明浮水印＋必要時加長下緣），FALSE 為投稿用
render_figure <- function(kind, m, type, digits, file, format = c("png", "pdf"), watermark = FALSE, plan = NULL) {
  format <- match.arg(format)
  if (watermark && is.null(plan)) plan <- plan_figure(kind, m, type, digits)
  H_css <- if (watermark) plan$H_css else fig_height_css(kind, m, type, digits)
  total_css <- if (watermark) plan$total_css else H_css
  open_device(file, format, total_css)
  ok <- FALSE
  on.exit(if (!ok) grDevices::dev.off())
  draw_content(kind, m, type, digits, top_frac = H_css / total_css)
  if (watermark) {
    g <- plan$geo; Wp <- FIG$css_w * FIG$scale; Hp <- total_css * FIG$scale
    img <- png::readPNG(FIG$wm_file)
    grid::grid.raster(img, x = grid::unit(g$x0 / Wp, "npc"), y = grid::unit(1 - g$y0 / Hp, "npc"),
                      width = grid::unit(g$ww / Wp, "npc"), height = grid::unit(g$wh / Hp, "npc"),
                      just = c("left", "top"), interpolate = TRUE)
  }
  grDevices::dev.off(); ok <- TRUE
  structure(c(width = FIG$css_w, height = total_css), plan = plan)   # plan：分享用圖的配置，下載 PDF 時重用
}

#' 檢查用：在「已加長、未加浮水印」的畫布上，數浮水印外框＋淨空區內的內容像素
wm_zone_content <- function(kind, m, type, digits, plan = NULL, extend = TRUE) {
  if (is.null(plan)) plan <- plan_figure(kind, m, type, digits)
  total_css <- if (extend) plan$total_css else plan$H_css
  W <- FIG$css_w * FIG$scale
  g <- if (extend) plan$geo else wm_geometry(W, plan$H_css * FIG$scale)
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png"); on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  open_device(tmp, "png", total_css); draw_content(kind, m, type, digits, top_frac = plan$H_css / total_css)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  nw <- nonwhite_px(tmp)
  r0 <- max(1, g$y0 - g$g + 1); r1 <- min(nrow(nw), g$y0 + g$wh + g$g)
  c0 <- max(1, g$x0 - g$g + 1); c1 <- min(ncol(nw), g$x0 + g$ww + g$g)
  list(content_px = sum(nw[r0:r1, c0:c1]), zone_px = (r1 - r0 + 1) * (c1 - c0 + 1),
       ext_css = plan$ext_css, total_css = total_css, geo = g)
}
